31898.s: The bill amends the Aviation Act to add a new title on the spatial effects of foreign airports on Dutch territory, allowing an algemene maatregel van bestuur to set a restricted area (beperkingengebied) around foreign airports such as Weeze, Brüggen and Geilenkirchen, with land-use rules, a permit regime run by the Minister of VROM, enforcement powers and appeal to the Raad van State. It also amends the Noise Nuisance Act accordingly and sets a five-year deadline for adopting the restricted-area decisions.
31898.j: The memorandum justifies centralising the power at national level because the foreign authority determines airport location and use, leaving little Dutch decision discretion, and aligns the rules with those for domestic airports.
q: National level was chosen because it concerns a strongly bound competence.
Voor het rijksniveau is gekozen omdat het een sterk gebonden bevoegdheid betreft.
d: establishing restricted area decision for named German airports
restricted area decision for any other foreign airport
land-use rules for military airports regarding external safety
rules on measuring, calculating and recording noise and external safety risk
rules on task, composition and working method of regional consultation committee
p: The Minister of VROM decides on exemptions (verklaring van geen bezwaar and ontheffing) from restricted-area rules, in agreement with the transport or defence minister, with a fixed decision period of eight weeks.
The Minister of VROM gains direct enforcement powers, including administrative enforcement orders and administrative fines, against land-use violations in the restricted area.
Appeal against the restricted-area decision lies in a single instance with the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State.

parties: Asks how compensation works, whether Dutch government building in restriction zones could force flight path changes, and whether foreign airlines can be obliged to join regional consultation.
The PvdA members also ask when the restriction area decision for Niederrhein, with the new Lden value, will be taken and what the status is of the plan for a group risk standard for Schiphol.

Tevens vragen de leden van de PvdA-fractie zich af wanneer het besluit beperkingengebied voor Niederrhein (met daarin de nieuwe Lden-waarde) genomen zal worden en wat de stand van zaken is met betrekking tot het voornemen om voor Schiphol te komen tot een groepsrisiconorm.
Argues the government seems to accept nuisance from foreign airports by only adjusting spatial policy, and asks how many people face serious nuisance.
The government does not seem to choose to limit the negative effects of airports and thereby implicitly accepts the nuisance for residents.
De regering lijkt er niet voor te kiezen om de negatieve effecten van luchthavens in te willen perken en zegt daarmee impliciet de overlast voor omwonenden te accepteren.

31965-X.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Ministry of Defence, adding a net 8,000 thousand euro to the spending and commitment figures as set out in the attached supplementary budget table. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2009, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

31997.s: The bill fully decentralises the setting of employment conditions in primary education, removing the national statutory framework and central consultation (articles 37 WPO and WEC) so that school boards set terms of employment themselves via civil-law employment contracts. It also makes related technical amendments, including removing the minister's role in dismissals, the directors' hearing, and forced partial dismissal, and corrects a gym-teaching qualification in special education.
31997.j: The memorandum justifies full decentralisation by evaluations of earlier decentralisation in higher, vocational and adult education showing it allows tailored employment conditions, as a logical follow-up to lump-sum funding.
q: With the present amendments to the WPO, WEC, Experimentenwet onderwijs and Wet medezeggenschap op scholen, the decentralisation of setting employment conditions in primary education is definitively arranged.

Met de onderhavige aanpassingen van de WPO, de WEC, de Experimentenwet onderwijs en de Wet medezeggenschap op scholen wordt de decentralisatie van de vorming van de arbeidsvoorwaarden in het primair onderwijs definitief geregeld.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel E (art. 33, tweede lid WPO)
salary scales and rules on leave, sick pay, dismissal benefits and other employee rights
Artikel II, onderdeel G (art. 33, tweede lid WEC)
salary scales and rules on leave, sick pay, dismissal benefits and other employee rights
Artikel I, onderdeel L (art. 138, eerste lid WPO)
ministerial rules on the funding reduction for employees hired ahead of others
p: Artikel I, onderdeel G en Artikel II, onderdeel I (art. 37 WPO/WEC)
Removes the statutory basis for central consultation with unions on employment conditions, moving the matter to school boards and their own agreements with unions.
Artikel I, onderdeel B en C, Artikel II, onderdeel C, E (art. 17, 29 WPO/WEC)
Replaces civil-service appointment with civil-law employment contracts and removes statutory staffing rules, giving school boards more discretion over staff.}
Artikel I, onderdeel P en Artikel II, onderdeel P (art. 183 WPO, 169 WEC)
Removes the possibility of forced partial dismissal (onvrijwillige taakvermindering) for staff, which narrows employees' legal protection against the employer.

parties: The CDA supports the transfer of the employer role to school boards as a logical final step and questions the wording of decentralisation, asking for it to be treated as irreversible.
Earlier the CDA members indicated they are in principle in favour of transferring the government's employer role to school boards.
Al eerder hebben de leden van de CDA-fractie laten weten principieel een voorstander te zijn van de overdracht van de werkgeversrol van de overheid aan de schoolbesturen.
The PvdA accepts the further decentralisation but asks how representative the PO-Raad is given low membership coverage and what checks and balances and budget safeguards exist.
These members attach great importance to this point given the necessary support base and the representative character of the PO-Raad.
Deze leden hechten zeer aan dit punt gelet op het benodigde draagvlak en het vertegenwoordigende karakter van de PO-Raad.
The SP views the bill as removing the government further from education and eroding parliamentary control, and questions the added bureaucracy, workload and pressure toward mergers.
With this, parliamentary control is increasingly disappearing from education.
Hiermee verdwijnt de parlementaire controle steeds meer uit het onderwijs.

The VVD welcomes full decentralisation as a logical consequence of lump-sum funding and reduced administrative burden, and asks about the bill's timing and whether school board leaders count as employees.
These members consider it a good thing that, as a logical consequence of lump-sum funding and reduced administrative burden, labour conditions in primary education are fully decentralised.

Deze leden vinden het een goede zaak dat als logisch gevolg van de lumpsumbekostiging in het primair onderwijs en de vermindering van bestuurlijke drukte de arbeidsvoorwaarden in het primair onderwijs volledig worden gedecentraliseerd.
The ChristenUnie asks questions about the representativeness of the PO-Raad and the position of small school boards, and about avoiding merger incentives.
These members ask about the consequences of the proposed bill for small school boards.
Deze leden vragen naar de gevolgen van voorliggend wetsvoorstel voor kleine schoolbesturen.

32360-IXA.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statement of the Nationale Schuld (national debt office) by adjusting its spending, commitment and revenue figures for the year. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amended budget effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Nationale Schuld (IXA) for the year 2009
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van de Nationale Schuld (IXA) voor het jaar 2009

32565-III.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the Queen and the Commission for the Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services, mainly by adding 3,118 thousand euro in expenditure in the first supplementary budget and reducing 2,646 thousand euro in the second. It is a routine budget adjustment tied to the Najaarsnota and sets the effective date as 1 December 2010.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2010 to the budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the Queen and the Commission for the Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services (III).

Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2010 wijzigingen aan te brengen in de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken, het Kabinet der Koningin en de Commissie van toezicht betreffende de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten (III).

32710-IXB.s: This bill adopts the final supplementary budget (slotwet) for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for 2010, amending the departmental budget statement and the baten-lastendiensten budgets for Domeinen Roerende Zaken and Rijksvastgoed- en Ontwikkelbedrijf. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the act retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.

32798.s: The bill cuts the child-related budget (kindgebonden budget) by removing the per-child payment for a third child, abolishing the article 6 entitlement, and introducing a wealth test that denies the benefit to households with savings-and-investment base of €80,000 or more, extended to 2010–2015. It also sets income and benefit amounts and provides for indexation of the wealth threshold by ministerial regulation.
32798.j: The memorandum justifies the cuts by the need to reduce the budget deficit and strengthen parents' own financial responsibility, and explains that indexation follows the tax-table correction used in the Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001.
q: It is in fact provided that there is no entitlement to the child-related budget where wealth taxed in box 3 is at least €80,000.
Bepaald wordt immers dat geen aanspraak bestaat op kindgebonden budget bij een vermogen van minstens € 80 000 dat in box 3 wordt belast.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel A (art. 1, vierde lid)
annual indexation of wealth threshold amount
Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 3, tweede lid)
other adjustments of amounts in the Act
p: Artikel I, onderdeel A (art. 1, vierde lid)
A wealth test is introduced with a fixed threshold that is indexed by ministerial regulation rather than by statute, reducing parliamentary control over the amount.

parties: Asks about the purpose of the child-related budget, its relation to other child schemes, the costs per measure and the income effects of the wealth test.
The VVD members see the need for the proposed measures but are curious to what extent this bill is connected to the revision of cuts to the other child schemes.

De leden van de VVD-fractie zien de noodzaak van de voorgestelde maatregelen in, maar zijn benieuwd in hoeverre onderhavig wetsvoorstel is betrokken bij de herziening van bezuinigingen op de overige kindregelingen.
Worries about effects on low-income households and children, asks for alternatives considered, including variants from a government review report, and requests detailed income-effect overviews.
The PvdA members are concerned about the effects on households with low incomes.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn bezorgd over de effecten voor de huishoudens met lage inkomens.
Asks how and how far in advance citizens will be informed of the change in amounts, and whether alternatives were considered to avoid extra structural implementation costs.
The PVV members ask whether the government considered alternatives to avoid 100,000 euro in extra structural implementation costs at the Tax Administration.
De leden van de PVV-fractie vragen of de regering alternatieven heeft overwogen om € 100 000 aan extra structurele uitvoeringskosten bij de Belastingsdienst te voorkomen?
Opposes cutting the budget aimed at lower incomes during the crisis and asks why means-testing child benefit or removing the budget from the third child was chosen instead.
The SP members point out that this government chooses to fight the economic crisis by harming precisely that group, the children, who had no influence whatsoever on that same crisis.

De leden van de SP-fractie wijzen erop dat deze regering ervoor kiest om de economische crisis te bestrijden door juist die groep te duperen, namelijk de kinderen, die totaal geen enkele invloed hebben gehad op diezelfde crisis.

Questions the choice to restrict the budget, notes the Council of State's point on the lack of knowledge about effectiveness of child schemes, and asks about the lack of a transitional arrangement for larger families.
These members note that the advisory division of the Council of State refers to the lack of knowledge about the effectiveness of the various child schemes that exist.
Deze leden stellen vast dat de afdeling advisering van de Raad van State verwijst naar het gebrek aan kennis over de effectiviteit van de verschillende kindregelingen die er bestaan.

Argues the measures could be fairer, questions the wealth test's departure from the general AWIR framework and its consistency with other child schemes, and raises administrative burden concerns flagged by Tax Administration.
Why the government, by introducing this wealth test, circumvents the operation of the General Act on Income-Dependent Schemes (AWIR).
Waarom de regering met de invoering van deze vermogenstoets de werking van de Algemene wet inkomensafhankelijke regelingen (AWIR) doorkruist.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises revisiting the proposed asset test for the kindgebonden budget and its deviation from the general Awir asset test, and asks for a broader reflection on child benefit schemes in light of the heroverwegingsrapport. The government's nader rapport explains the chosen asset threshold by its income effects, limiting affected households to about four percent, and adds the justification to the explanatory memorandum.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for a fuller consideration of the chosen measures against heroverwegingsrapport nr. 5 and alternatives; the government points to the forthcoming toekomstperspectief and the need for quick, easily implementable savings.

The Afdeling finds the choice of a very high asset threshold (box 3 base above EUR 80,000) insufficiently justified and asks for reconsideration of the deviation from Awir article 7(3); the government justifies the threshold by limiting income losses to about four percent of households and expands the memorie van toelichting.

Editorial remarks on article I B (age and eligibility conditions for the oldest two children, and wording of the second paragraph) and on aligning article II with the entry-into-force provision of article III are adopted.

33599.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2011/62 by amending the Medicines Act to add rules against falsified medicines, including new registration duties for active-substance manufacturers and intermediaries, verification of safety features, online sales rules, and inspection and reporting duties. It adds numerous ministerial and administrative delegations for detailed rules and expands administrative fines.
33599.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly as necessary technical detail to implement the EU directive, citing EU rules and the need for detailed, flexible standards.
q: These requirements will be designated by ministerial regulation.
Bij ministeriële regeling zullen deze voorschriften worden aangewezen.
d: good manufacturing and distribution practice rules for medicines and active substances
registration of active substance manufacturers and distributors
rules for distance selling of medicines
additional rules on distance sales to protect public health
labelling and package leaflet requirements, safety features
labelling rules for research and pharmacy-prepared medicines
exemption from chapter 7 labelling rules granted by the College
rules for checking safety features of medicines
permission to start activities before 60-day period ends
exemption from import rule for active substances
p: Inspections of manufacturers and distributors may be carried out at the request of foreign authorities or the Commission, expanding the supervisory agency's discretion.
Artikel I, I (art. 38d) and I (art. 39a, lid 2)
The minister may strike off registration of active-substance manufacturers and intermediaries who fail to comply, a discretionary sanction affecting their ability to operate.
The minister may impose administrative fines up to EUR 450,000 for breaches of a wider list of provisions, including the new active-substance and intermediary rules.
The Staatstoezicht op de volksgezondheid reports non-compliance to the EudraGMP database and the minister, a routine information duty.

parties: Asks whether the expected benefits of the additional rules justify the increase in regulation and whether the bill goes further than the directive.
This leads to an increase in laws and regulations. Against this stand the (expected) benefits.
Dit leidt tot een toename van wet- en regelgeving. Daar staan (verwachte) baten tegenover.
Welcomes closing the distribution chain but asks what safeguards exist for licensing, whether the IGZ can absorb extra tasks, and argues for a general safety-feature requirement.
However, these members ask what safeguards exist around the granting of licences.
Wel vragen deze leden welke waarborgen er bestaan rondom het verlenen van vergunningen.
Critical of the CBG's strictness and independence, the IGZ's risk-based inspections, the discretion to deviate from safety features, and the registration of intermediaries without prior inspection.
Said members have doubts about this power and ask why the government chose to include this power in the law.
Genoemde leden hebben twijfels bij deze bevoegdheid, en vragen waarom de regering ervoor gekozen heeft deze bevoegdheid in de wet op te nemen.
Asks why a ministerial regulation rather than a general administrative measure is used for exemptions, and questions the lack of formal cooperation arrangements among enforcement bodies.
These are conditions from which deviations from the core of the bill may be made.
Het gaat om voorwaarden waarbij van de kern van het wetsvoorstel afgeweken mag worden.
Asks whether the IGZ has sufficient capacity for its increased workload and how trade outside the EU is covered by the registration system.
ask whether the government trusts that the current capacity of the IGZ (and the recently planned expansion) is sufficient to carry out this increase in work correctly.

vragen of de regering vertrouwt dat de huidige capaciteit van de IGZ (en de recent voorgenomen uitbreiding daarvan) voldoende is om deze toename in werkzaamheden op correcte wijze te kunnen uitvoeren.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill implementing Directive 2011/62/EU against falsified medicines is broadly supported but that the missed implementation deadline must be addressed, including the transitional registration provision in proposed article 122a. The minister's reply removed article 122a, explained the consequences of the missed deadline in the explanatory memorandum, and followed nearly all drafting remarks except one.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the government to address the consequences of the missed implementation deadline and interim measures such as registration, and to amend proposed article 122a accordingly.

Several redactional remarks on definitions and cross-references in the bill were proposed and adopted, except the addition in the third bullet which the government deemed unnecessary given general private law.

33605-IV.s: This bill amends the 2012 departmental budget statement for Kingdom Relations (budget chapter IV), adjusting the budgeted and realised amounts for the policy articles on guarantees and on promoting autonomy of Kingdom partners. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no explanatory memorandum is available.
q: the departmental budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2012 is amended
de departementale begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd

33605-VI.s: This supplementary budget bill (slotwet) amends the 2012 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice and the related baten-lastendiensten budget statement, adjusting appropriations and realisations by line item. It sets amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force the day after publication, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Amendment of the budget statements of the Ministry of Security and Justice (VI) for the year 2012 (final budget act)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2012 (slotwet)

33698.s: The bill amends the Civil Code (Boek 7) and the Uitvoeringswet huurprijzen woonruimte to modernise rent-determination procedures before the rent commission, redefining utility and service costs, extending notice periods, and setting default amounts the commission may impose. It also removes administrative-law appeal routes against rent-commission legal-fee decisions, channelling disputes to the civil court instead.
33698.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations and procedural changes as modernising and simplifying the rent commission's work and clarifying the landlord's duties and the commission's role for disputes of a financial nature.
q: The bill provides in article III that a separate legal route under the Awb regarding the legal-fee judgment is excluded.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet er in artikel III in dat een (afzonderlijke) rechtsgang op grond van de Awb ten aanzien van de legesveroordeling wordt uitgesloten.
d: fixed service-cost amounts where no agreement exists
designating items counted as service costs
raising or lowering admissibility monetary thresholds
default service-cost amount when form missing or incomplete
p: Allows the rent commission to set rents ex officio at 55% of the agreed price before ruling, expanding its discretion over tenants and landlords.
Lets the commission fix service costs at a statutory or default amount, or zero, when the landlord's form is missing or incomplete.
Excludes administrative-law objection and appeal against rent-commission legal-fee decisions, so such disputes go to the civil court instead of the administrative courts.

parties: Supports simplification and less juridification but finds the fee gap between tenant (25 euro) and landlord (450 euro) substantial and asks whether it disproportionately hits small landlords, and questions the disproportionate all-in sanction.

The difference between the amount the tenant owes after being found wrong (25 euro) and the amount the landlord must pay in that situation (450 euro) is however, in the view of these members, substantial.

Het verschil tussen het bedrag dat de huurder is verschuldigd nadat zij in het ongelijk is gesteld (25 euro) en het bedrag dat de verhuurder in die situatie moet betalen (450 euro) is echter naar het oordeel van deze leden substantieel.
Worries that the all-in rent rules could leave tenants with rent above the points-based maximum and asks how the commission can guarantee compliance with the WWS points system.
How is it guaranteed that the attributed amount on which the sanction is based is in accordance with the WWS?
Hoe wordt gegarandeerd dat het toegerekende bedrag waarop de sanctie wordt gebaseerd, conform het WWS is?
Argues the all-in construction should be banned for transparency, that the tenant's position is weakened, and that the new sanction could leave tenants worse off than before.
Why is it not chosen to ban the all-in construction?
Waarom wordt er niet voor gekozen de all-in constructie te verbieden?
Questions the higher fee burden on landlords versus tenants, the basis for the distinction, and how the kantonrechter can decide on state fee claims without statutory authority.
Without a statutory mandate the kantonrechter is not competent to decide in a procedure between tenant and landlord on the state's fee claims.
Zonder wettelijke opdracht is de kantonrechter niet bevoegd om in een procedure tussen huurder en verhuurder te beslissen over de legesaanspraken van de staat.
Asks about the effects on small landlords and whether higher landlord-individual fee numbers reflect attempts to avoid the higher tariff.
These members note that a large majority of cases before the rent commission concern small landlords, who will face a raised tariff.
Deze leden constateren dat een ruime meerderheid van de zaken bij de huurcommissie kleine verhuurders betreft, die met een verhoogd tarief geconfronteerd zullen worden.

v.summary: The Council of State advised that the bill's shift from a natural-person/legal-entity fee distinction to a tenant/landlord distinction (landlords always paying €450) needed better justification, especially for small landlords just above the fee-waiver income threshold, and noted inconsistency with fee rules in other courts. The minister's reply explains the administrative burden on the Huurcommissie, justifies the higher fee for losing landlords, expands the explanatory memorandum, and follows most drafting remarks except two.
concerns: The Council questioned the unclear rationale for the tenant/landlord fee distinction and asked for it to be substantiated in the explanatory memorandum, which the minister supplemented with administrative-burden data.

The Council warned the €450 fee could be an excessive burden for small landlords whose income is just above the waiver threshold; the minister justified it by stimulating self-resolution and compliance but did not add a new exemption.

The Council noted the deviation from the natural-person/legal-entity distinction used in civil and administrative court fees undermines legal uniformity; the minister accepted the deviation as justified by the burden on the commission.

The Council made several redactional remarks, including renumbering of service-cost categories, expressing a term in months, and precise statutory cross-references; most were adopted, but the Civil Code reference remark under aanwijzing 83b was not followed.

33788.s: The bill merges the municipalities of Bergambacht, Nederlek, Ouderkerk, Schoonhoven and Vlist into a new municipality called Krimpenerwaard, effective the day after publication in the Staatsblad. It also sets transitional rules for a by-election, adjusts the judicial district and safety region lists, and designates Nederlek to handle preparations.
33788.j: The memorandum justifies immediate entry into force, departing from the usual Vaste Verandermomenten system, because postponement would cause disproportionate disadvantages to the municipalities.
q: This deviation is permissible, since postponement – given the wish of the majority of the municipalities and the province for reorganisation per 1 January 2015 – would lead to excessive disadvantages for the municipalities.

Deze afwijking is geoorloofd, nu uitstel – gelet op de wens van de meerderheid van de gemeenten en de provincie tot herindeling per 1 januari 2015 – zou leiden tot buitensporige nadelen voor de gemeenten.

parties: Notes broad support among regional administrators and endorsement by government and province; raises no questions.
This bill therefore gives the VVD members no reason to ask questions.
Dit wetsvoorstel geeft de leden van de VVD-fractie dan ook geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen.
Supports swift decision but questions whether the merger has sufficient internal support and the effects of possibly altering the bill to include Krimpen aan den IJssel.
These members still have a number of questions about the bill before us.
Bij deze leden leeft wel nog een aantal vragen over het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Asks why no referendum or representative survey was held to gauge residents' views, arguing merger should match majority wishes.
why no referendum and not even a representative survey has been held to learn how residents of the municipalities think about the merger.
waarom er geen referendum en zelfs geen representatief onderzoek heeft plaatsgevonden om te weten te komen hoe de inwoners van de betreffende gemeenten over de herindeling denken.
Argues the merger lacks broad support and was imposed top-down by the province, with local municipalities opposed and residents largely against.
Both administratively and socially there is no broad support for the proposal.
Zowel bestuurlijk als maatschappelijk is geen sprake van een breed draagvlak
Stresses the preference for bottom-up mergers and asks whether including Krimpen aan den IJssel would bypass residents' consultation and risk Senate rejection.
It has become clear to the CDA members that people value their local communities.
Het is de leden van de CDA-fractie duidelijk geworden dat de mensen hechten aan hun lokale gemeenschappen
Supports scaling up for capacity but asks how the new municipality will sustain village-level participation and whether financial differences pose risks.
An active village-core policy will strengthen the legitimacy of the new municipality, because residents will remain heard.
Een actief dorpskernenbeleid zal de legitimatie van de nieuwe gemeente versterken, omdat inwoners gehoord zullen blijven
Asks how heavily the support criterion weighs given municipal majorities favouring independence, and how the risk of an unsuccessful bottom-up process is assessed.
ask how heavily the support criterion weighs.
vragen hoe zwaar het toetsingscriterium van het draagvlak weegt
Questions whether the merger is justified, whether cooperation would suffice, and whether the bestuurskracht data from nearly a decade ago is still valid.
Is the assumption that merger is automatically better than cooperation not too easy?
Is niet te gemakkelijk de vooronderstelling dat herindeling automatisch beter is dan samenwerking?

33797.s: The bill amends the Wet bijzondere maatregelen grootstedelijke problematiek (Wbmgp) to extend the designation of problem areas to smaller municipalities, allow the designation period to be renewed up to four times, and add a personal data definition. It also amends the Huisvestingswet to allow municipalities to designate neighbourhoods where conversion of buildings into two or more dwellings requires a permit, and makes non-compliance with permit conditions a ground for refusal.
33797.j: The memorandum justifies the extended designation powers as necessary to tackle big-city problems and notes the minister must test proportionality and may withdraw designations that are no longer suitable.
q: In addition, the Minister for Housing and Central Government Affairs retains the power to withdraw the area designation if it becomes apparent in the meantime that the designation is no longer suitable or proportionate for tackling the problem.

Daarnaast behoudt de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst de bevoegdheid om de gebiedsaanwijzing in te trekken indien tussentijds zou blijken dat de aanwijzing niet langer geschikt of proportioneel is voor de aanpak van de problematiek.
d: definitions and designation of problem areas via ministerial designation
p: Removes the population threshold for designating problem areas and allows the designation period to be renewed up to four times, extending the minister's power to restrict housing access for residents with few years in the region.
Artikel II, onderdeel A and B (Huisvestingswet artikel 30 and 38)
Allows municipalities to require permits for conversion of buildings into multiple dwellings in designated neighbourhoods and lets permits be refused for non-compliance with conditions.

parties: Warns that new measures must be used only within clear frameworks, questions whether property rights and freedom of settlement are respected, and asks how to prevent municipalities from creating unfounded regulation.
These special and far-reaching measures, in their view, must not be deployed lightly.
Deze bijzondere en verstrekkende maatregelen mogen volgens hen niet lichtvaardig worden ingezet.
Supports the measures in principle but asks for renewed proof of necessity every four years and questions why certain provisions are left out.
However, they believe that every four years it must be proven anew that the need for the measures still exists.
Wel vinden ze dat elke vier jaar opnieuw bewezen moet worden dat de noodzaak voor de maatregelen er nog steeds is.
Sceptical that excluding large groups of housing seekers without proven misconduct is justified, and that extending the measures for up to twenty years is merely a sign of failure.
The bill opts to exclude a large group of housing seekers from a substantial part of the housing market without it being established that those persons have engaged in antisocial conduct.

Aan de repressiekant valt op dat het wetsvoorstel kiest voor een uitsluiting van een grote groep woningzoekenden van de toegang tot een substantieel deel van de woningmarkt zonder dat vast staat dat de personen in kwestie zich schuldig gemaakt hebben aan onmaatschappelijk gedrag.
Asks about broader grounds for refusing housing seekers and about forced eviction and separate camps for nuisance-causers.
These members ask the government to develop plans for mandatory evictions in cases of structural nuisance and for more nuisance villages.
Deze leden vragen de regering plannen te ontwikkelen om verplicht over te gaan op huisuitzettingen bij structurele overlast en meer tuigdorpen (asodorpen) in te richten.
Notes that the bill seriously infringes fundamental rights such as freedom of settlement and privacy, and asks whether restrictions will always be necessary and proportionate.
They also believe the proposal contains far-reaching measures that seriously infringe the fundamental rights of freedom of settlement and respect for private life in the case of the housing permit.

Ook zijn zij van mening dat het voorstel ingrijpende maatregelen bevat die in het geval van de huisvestingsvergunning ernstig inbreuk maken op de grondrechten vrijheid van vestiging en de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Asks by whom and on what criteria extensions and woningvorming bans will be reviewed, and how proportionality and free settlement will be weighed.
How is the proportionality and reasonableness of an extension of an area designation reviewed, and how heavily are the principles of free settlement weighed in that?
Hoe wordt de proportionaliteit en redelijkheid van een verlenging van gebiedsaanwijzing getoetst en hoe zwaar worden de principes van vrije vestiging daarin meegewogen?
Asks whether the text makes clear that the same review criteria apply when an area designation is extended, since article 6 refers only to the first application.
They ask whether the current statutory text sufficiently makes clear that the same review criteria also apply when the term is extended.
Zij vragen of de huidige wetstekst voldoende duidelijk maakt dat ook bij verlenging van de termijn dezelfde toetsingscriteria worden gehanteerd.
Asks whether municipalities must justify specific neighbourhood designations and whether the criteria for merging dwellings can be relaxed.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the draft Wet uitbreiding Wbmgp, which would let municipalities require criminal-record screening of housing applicants via VOG and police data, and allow restricting conversion of dwellings. The Afdeling found the necessity of the broader measures (police-data screening, dwelling conversion ban, OZB changes) insufficiently shown and advised reconsidering them; the minister's reply withdrew the police-data screening from this bill and accepted the evaluation and redactional points.
concerns: The necessity of the extension beyond existing instruments was not convincingly shown; government kept the VOG option but withdrew police-data screening from this bill.
Use of police data on all household members and unlimited duration was judged disproportionate to the freedom of establishment and private life.
Interference with freedom of establishment and privacy requires necessity and proportionality, and safeguards are lacking.
Screening framework left to delegated regulation; the Afdeling advised putting basic conditions in the statute itself, which the reply did not expressly address.
Dwelling-conversion refusal grounds of neighbourhood liveability are not in the text of article 31 Huisvestingswet; the reply denied new grounds but did not resolve the ambiguity.
Effectiveness of screening is doubtful where disorder is caused by outsiders or new residents from abroad; the Afdeling asked for this in the explanatory memorandum.
The OZB 100,000-inhabitant threshold removal should be explained against EU state-aid rules; the reply explained the de minimis treatment.
Evaluation should cover all Wbmgp instruments every five years rather than only the new measures.
Redactional points on structure, wording and duplicate passages were adopted.

33995.s: The bill amends the Dutch Weapons and Ammunition Act to implement EU Regulation 258/2012 on export authorisations for firearms, their parts, components and ammunition. It adds a new export section requiring export licences for listed items and lets ministerial regulation set rules for transit approval and simplified procedures.
33995.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the administrative nature of the procedural rules and by the aim of limiting administrative burdens on exporters while implementing an EU regulation.
q: Because these procedural rules are administrative in nature, article 20a(6) of the Weapons and Ammunition Act proposes that these simplified procedures be set by ministerial regulation.
Vanwege de administratieve aard van deze procedurele regels, wordt in artikel 20a, zesde lid, Wwm voorgesteld om deze vereenvoudigde procedures vast te stellen bij ministeriële regeling.
d: rules implementing transit no-objection procedure under Art. 7(2) of Regulation 258/2012
simplified procedures for re-export and temporary export cases
minister may grant exemption from prohibitions for export of silencers
minister may designate customs licences as export licences after consultation with another minister
minister may issue exemptions from consent requirement, without prejudice to Regulation 258/2012
p: Articles 14 to 16 and 20 on consents do not apply to exports of listed items that also count as exports under the Regulation, shifting that case to the export licence regime.
The minister may grant exemptions from prohibitions on exporting silencers, a discretionary power limited to one item category.
Extends criminal and administrative sanction provisions to breaches of the new export prohibition, a sanctioning power of the executive.

parties: Worries that vague component terminology could allow retroactive criminalisation and that repeated ministerial exemptions for silencers make the law complex and hard to enforce.
As far as these members are concerned, the law is thereby unnecessarily complicated and difficult to enforce.
Wat de leden van de VVD-fractie betreffen wordt de wet op deze manier onnodig gecompliceerd en moeilijk handhaafbaar.
Asks how the tax authority is informed of revoked licences, how personal data is protected, and whether the twenty-year retention period is proportionate.
In what way is account taken of the protection of personal data in this context?
Op welke manier wordt hierbij voorts rekening gehouden met de bescherming van de persoonsgegevens?
Asks why the Wwm rather than the Awb governs objection rights, whether the twenty-day no-objection period is adequate, and whether sanctions should be stricter.
They also ask whether, given the care required in the import and transit of weapons, explicit consent should not generally be preferred over 'no objection'.

Zij vragen ook of, gelet op de zorgvuldigheid die betracht moet worden bij de in- en doorvoer van wapens, expliciete toestemming eigenlijk niet altijd de voorkeur zou moeten verdienen boven «geen bezwaar.»
Supports the bill's aim and asks only for estimates of illegal weapon movements and how they are tackled.
They support the aim of the bill and have only a single question about it.
Zij onderschrijven het doel van het wetsvoorstel en hebben hierover slechts een enkele vraag.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports the bill amending the Weapons and Ammunition Act to implement EU Regulation 258/2012 on firearms export licensing, but objects to delegating rule-making on transit no-objection to the Minister and asks for a wrongly cited article 13 to be removed and a separate provision for silencers. The government's reply (nader rapport) follows the advice: the article 13 reference is removed, a separate silencer provision is added, and the delegation is retained at ministerial-regulation level with a justification.
concerns: The Afdeling asked why rule-making power under article 7(2) of the regulation is delegated to the Minister, arguing the rules are not administrative or detailed enough to warrant it; the government kept ministerial delegation, citing consistency with existing practice.
Article 13 Wwm was wrongly referenced in the proposed article 20a and should be deleted, since it contains a prohibition rather than a consent requirement.
Silencers fall under category I and are subject to a prohibition rather than consent, so a separate provision for silencers should be added.

Several redactional corrections were proposed, including deleting references to the European Union in the preamble and article I, correcting the terminology from European Communities, and clarifying references to Annex I.

34350-IX.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts by article. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statements of the Ministry of Finance for the year 2015
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Financiën voor het jaar 2015

34499.s: The bill approves the 2016 treaty between the Netherlands and Kosovo on hosting the Kosovo Relocated Specialist Judicial Institution in the Netherlands, and authorises the government to agree treaty extensions without further parliamentary approval. The explanatory memorandum says the treaty's interim status and the specialist chambers' international judges and procedural safeguards support its legal basis.
34499.j: The memorandum justifies the automatic extension by noting the treaty's temporary nature and that the Institution's establishment and work are of a temporary character.
q: Extensions do not require Staten-Generaal approval under article 7(e) of the Rgbv; in this case authorisation for automatic extension is requested, bypassing the pre-consultation procedure.

Verlengingen behoeven op grond van artikel 7, onderdeel e, van de Rgbv niet de goedkeuring van de Staten-Generaal; in dit geval wordt gevraagd om machtiging tot automatische verlenging, met voorbijgaan aan de voorhangprocedure
p: The government may extend the treaty automatically without the parliamentary pre-consultation procedure that would otherwise apply under the Rgbv.

parties: Asks the government for timing estimates, costs, a building, and whether it will prepare a termination bill if EU funding fails, seeking clearer government commitments to parliament.
Can the government commit that, if financing can no longer be realised by the EU, it will immediately proceed to prepare a bill aimed at terminating the treaty?

Kan de regering toezeggen dat, indien financiering niet meer door de EU verwezenlijkt kan worden, zij direct overgaat tot het voorbereiden van een wetsvoorstel dat het voornemen tot opzegging van het verdrag tot strekking heeft?

34550-IV.s: This bill sets the 2017 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds, in thousands of euros, and enters into force on 1 January 2017. The explanatory memorandum covers financial supervision of the Caribbean islands, the Rijksministerraad's intervention powers, and related spending on policing, coastguard and judiciary.
q: The bill aims to establish the budget statements in question for the year indicated.
Het wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om de onderhavige begrotingsstaten voor het aangegeven jaar vast te stellen.

34550-VI.s: This bill fixes the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice and the budget statements for its agencies (DJI, CJIB, NFI, IND, Justis), in thousands of euros. It also clarifies that the minister is not responsible for the efficiency of court administration but keeps a supervisory responsibility over the Raad voor de rechtspraak.
34550-VI.j: The memorandum justifies the clarified division of responsibilities by the institution of the Raad voor de rechtspraak and integral management of the courts, which shifts administrative responsibility to the judiciary.
q: Under articles 93 and 105 to 107 of the Judicial Organisation Act, the Minister of Security and Justice has a supervisory responsibility towards the Council for the Judiciary.

Onze Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie heeft op grond van de artikelen 93 en 105 tot en met 107 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie een toezichthoudende verantwoordelijkheid ten aanzien van de Raad voor de rechtspraak.

34620-IX.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2016 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It creates no delegation of rule-making power and does not alter oversight or judicial review.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2016 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34679.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act and the Housing Act to establish a national electronic asbestos tracking system (LAVS) and to allow general administrative orders to require asbestos-related information to be submitted solely electronically. It also makes several technical amendments, including enforcement via penalty orders for emission rights and immediate entry into force for certain GMO decisions.
34679.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for detailed, flexible and technical rules and by the EU directive requiring immediate effect for GMO decisions.
q: The bill has no consequences for citizens, businesses and institutions and brings no change in rights and obligations, administrative burdens or implementation burdens.
Het wetsvoorstel heeft geen gevolgen voor burgers, bedrijven en instellingen en brengt geen verandering in rechten en verplichtingen, administratieve lasten of uitvoeringslasten teweeg.
d: contents, access and retention periods of the national asbestos tracking system
further detailed rules for proper implementation of the system
electronic reporting and submission of asbestos-related data, deviating from the general electronic-communication rule in the Awb
mandatory electronic demolition notification and asbestos removal documentation, deviating from the Awb default
further detailed rules on electronic demolition notification
designating GMO decisions that take effect the day after publication
p: Personal data of asbestos-project actors is centralised in a ministry-run system, with access and retention to be set by general administrative order.
ARTIKEL I, C (artikel 9.2.2.1b Wm) and ARTIKEL II (artikel 2 lid 5 Woningwet)
Removes the general Awb option of submitting asbestos information in writing, making electronic submission mandatory by order in council-type regulation, deviating from the statutory default.
Allows certain GMO decisions to take effect before the appeal period ends, limiting judicial and third-party protection, justified by an EU directive.

parties: Asks whether municipalities should play a more active role in mapping asbestos buildings and how risk-based supervision would work without knowing where asbestos is.
Should municipalities not be given a more active role in creating an overall picture of the buildings where asbestos has been used in their municipalities?
Zouden gemeenten niet een actievere rol moeten krijgen bij het creëren van een totaalbeeld van de panden waar asbest is gebruikt in hun gemeenten?
Questions why citizens cannot access their own asbestos data directly and whether voluntary registration of low-risk removal should be allowed.
Why would they not be allowed to search for information in it, for example about their own or future properties or homes?
Waarom zouden ze daar echter geen informatie in op mogen zoeken, bijvoorbeeld over hun eigen of aanstaande panden of woningen?
Asks why the implementing AMvB is not submitted together with the bill, so that its reach and regulatory burden can be assessed jointly.
Is it not the case that the scope and the accompanying regulatory burden of the bill only become clear through the elaboration in the AMvB, and that they should therefore be assessed together?

Is het niet zo dat de reikwijdte en de daarmee gepaard gaande regeldruk die uit het wetsvoorstel voortkomt pas duidelijk wordt door uitwerking in de AMvB en dat deze daarom gezamenlijk beoordeeld zouden moeten worden?
Welcomes the LAVS but asks for the privacy impact assessment, safeguards against unauthorised access, and why no internet consultation was held or the AMvB is not shared with parliament.

These members also ask whether the government intends to submit to the House the AMvB which, unlike this amendment, can contain matters with significant consequences for citizens, companies and institutions.

Deze leden vragen voorts of de regering voornemens is om de AMvB waarin, in tegenstelling tot deze wetswijziging, wel degelijk zaken in verwerkt kunnen worden die noemenswaardige gevolgen hebben voor burgers, bedrijven en instellingen, voor te leggen aan de Kamer.
Asks how the government will actively inform citizens that information about them in the system can be requested and why citizens cannot easily obtain their own file.
Should it not be possible for a private individual to request their own file with a simple action?
Zou het niet mogelijk moeten zijn om met een simpele handeling als particulier het eigen dossier op te kunnen vragen?
Supports mandatory use but asks for evaluation after one year, enforcement capacity, and the sanctions available for non-compliance.
Can the government provide an overview of the sanctions that can be imposed on parties that do not (timely) meet the statutory information obligation?
Kan de regering een overzicht geven van de sanctiemaatregelen die kunnen worden opgelegd aan partijen die niet (tijdig) voldoen aan de wettelijke informatieverplichting?
Reports that the current LAVS malfunctions and asks the government to guarantee a usable, problem-free system before making its use mandatory.
Can the government guarantee that the system will be improved before it is made mandatory so that it is user-friendly and functions without problems?
Kan de regering garanderen dat het systeem alvorens het verplicht gesteld wordt zodanig verbeterd wordt dat het gebruiksvriendelijk is en zonder problemen functioneert?

34688.s: The bill transposes EU Directive 2015/2302 on package travel and linked travel arrangements into Dutch civil law (Book 7 BW Title 7A), setting information duties, contract change and cancellation rules, liability, and insolvency protection for travellers. It also designates the Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) as the central contact point and enforcer, with the power to impose administrative fines and penalty orders.
34688.j: The memorandum justifies the regime by the directive's full harmonisation objective and the need for administrative cooperation and supervision of organisers active across member states.
q: The Authority for Consumers and Markets is designated as the central contact point, referred to in Article 18(2) of Directive (EU) 2015/2302.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt wordt aangewezen als het centrale contactpunt, bedoeld in artikel 18, tweede lid, van Richtlijn (EU) 2015/2302
p: Artikel III C (Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming, bijlage a en artikel 8.7)
The ACM is designated as central contact point and enforcer, with power to impose administrative fines and penalty orders on organisers and facilitators, subject to ordinary legal remedies.

parties: Questions whether the directive and its implementation go beyond what is necessary, and asks about the unclear definition of linked travel arrangements, high compliance costs and the optional provisions.

Given the input of the Dutch government during the negotiation of this new directive, however, these members believe that the proposed directive and its implementation in Dutch legislation go further than necessary to achieve the aforementioned objectives.

Mede gelet op de inbreng van de Nederlandse regering tijdens de behandeling van deze nieuwe richtlijn zijn deze leden echter van mening dat de voorgestelde richtlijn en de implementatie ervan in de Nederlandse wetgeving verder gaat dan noodzakelijk om de voornoemde doelstellingen te behalen.
Asks how the government will handle problems from full harmonisation that the Netherlands opposed, and asks about evaluation of effects and clarity on key terms.
To what extent does the government expect problems on the aforementioned points, and what options does it see to address these problems now and in the future?
In welke mate verwacht de regering op de voornoemde punten problemen en welke mogelijkheden ziet de regering om die problemen nu en in de toekomst te ondervangen?
Asks whether full harmonisation weakens existing consumer protection and how consumers will be informed about which law applies to linked travel arrangements.
These members ask the government to explain how the distinction should be made and how the consumer will be informed about when which law and directive applies.
Deze leden vragen de regering toe te lichten hoe het onderscheid dient te worden gemaakt en hoe de consument geïnformeerd zal worden over wanneer welke wet en richtlijn van toepassing is.

34725-III.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2016 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, the Oversight Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services, and the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie. It records realised spending and revenue against the adopted and supplementary budgets, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statements
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaten

34730-IV.s: The bill amends the 2017 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (chapter IV) and the BES Fund (chapter H) through a first supplementary budget, adjusting appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 1 June 2017, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) and the budget statement of the BES Fund (H), all for the year 2017;

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) en van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds (H), alle voor het jaar 2017;

34730-VI.s: This first supplementary budget for 2017 amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice and the financial statements of several agencies (DJI, IND, CJIB, NFI, JUSTIS), mainly increasing spending and revenue lines by parliamentary budget law. It does not delegate rule-making or shift powers away from parliament, courts or citizens.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice for the year 2017
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2017

34769.s: The bill expands the AFM and DNB's powers to publish overtredingen and warnings about financial institutions and accounting firms, with procedural safeguards such as waiting periods, suspensive effect of interim relief, and closed-door hearings. It also aligns the AFM's publication rules under the Wta with the Wft's legal protection framework.
34769.j: The memorandum justifies the expanded publication powers by the need for transparency to restore trust in financial supervision, prevent harm to the public, and strengthen compliance.
q: It is therefore proposed to give supervisors, in situations where harm can be prevented, the power to publish all violations of provisions applying under the Wft or regulations based on it.

Daarom wordt voorgesteld om de toezichthouders in situaties waarin schade kan worden voorkomen de bevoegdheid te geven om alle overtredingen van voorschriften die gelden op grond van de Wft of daarop gebaseerde regelgeving en besluiten die zij hebben vastgesteld openbaar te maken.
d: publication of violations of other provisions designated by general administrative order
periodicity and procedure for publishing non-aggregated bank data
p: The supervisor may publicly warn about any violation of a Wft provision and name the offender when needed to prevent or limit harm, extending publication beyond the previous narrow list of violations.

The supervisor may publish on a shortened or immediate basis, bypassing the standard waiting period, when the offender has itself disclosed information, with only a best-efforts duty to notify the party beforehand.
Lists grounds on which publication must be withheld, including disproportionate harm, ongoing criminal investigations and threats to financial stability.
The AFM may publish accounting-firm sanctions on a shortened or immediate basis when the firm has itself disclosed the violation, skipping the usual waiting period.

parties: Questions the risk of premature or lightly used publication powers, the limited liability of supervisors, the lack of interim relief safeguards and the proportionality of the powers.
More and faster publicity is however a heavy power, because if acting wrongly the damage to the person or institution concerned can be large.
Meer en snellere openbaarheid is echter een zware bevoegdheid, omdat bij foutief handelen de schade voor de betrokken persoon of instelling groot kan zijn.
Supports the bill but asks about the role of other supervisors in publication decisions and the handling of objections by other supervisors.
Do they also have a role in the decision to make information public?
Hebben zij ook nog een rol in de beslissing informatie openbaar te maken?
Asks who decides whether an emergency exists, whether an independent body oversees that decision, and how affected parties can obtain corrections.
Is there an independent body or committee that oversees this decision?
Is er een onafhankelijke instantie of commissie die meekijkt met betrekking tot deze beslissing?
Criticises the government for following the Council of State's negative advice on publishing investigation results and presses for broader transparency and discipline of the financial sector.
Can the government explain why it follows the negative advice of the Council of State regarding publishing investigation results.
Kan de regering verklaren waarom zij meegaat in het negatief advies van de Afdeling aangaande het publiceren van onderzoeksresultaten.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering advised against sending the bill to parliament until remarks were addressed, mainly that the power to publish identifiable investigation reports conflicts with the closed EU confidentiality regime and that the balancing of interests and legal protection before publication were insufficiently addressed. The government's reply accepted removing the general power to publish investigation reports, clarified the basis for warnings, reframed the balancing-of-interests text, added an information duty before urgent publication, and a transposition table.
concerns: The general power to publish investigation reports with identifiable institutions conflicts with EU confidentiality rules; the government dropped the general power but kept warnings and gave a basis for them.
The explanatory memorandum presumed publication takes priority over confidentiality, which conflicts with the balancing required by Article 1:96; the government revised the text on this point.

Immediate urgent publication leaves affected parties without a chance to seek interim relief, and damages are limited; the government added an information duty and clarified the position of affected parties.
The explanatory memorandum should include a transposition table showing how each relevant EU provision is implemented; the government added the legal basis for each power.

34775-V.s: This bill fixes the 2018 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in thousands of euros, with budgeted expenditure of about EUR 9.5 billion and receipts of about EUR 752 million. It sets the unit of account, the entry into force date (1 January 2018, with retroactive effect if published later), and orders publication and implementation.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2018 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2018 wordt vastgesteld.

34787.s: The bill abolishes the VAT agricultural scheme (btw-landbouwregeling) by repealing its provisions in the Dutch VAT Act 1968 and the related references in the excise, environmental tax and renewable energy surcharge laws. It also sets transitional rules for the deduction and adjustment of VAT on goods and services in use on 1 January 2018.
34787.j: The memorandum justifies the entry-into-force date by citing budgetary consequences and the fiscal year schedule, and invokes the advisory referendum act for early commencement.
q: Postponing entry into force beyond this date is undesirable given the budgetary consequences for the budget and the fiscal year calendar.
Uitstel van de inwerkingtreding tot na deze datum is, gelet op de budgettaire gevolgen voor de begroting en de fiscale jaarindeling, ongewenst.

parties: Asks about the financial consequences for farmers, the use of the revenue, the short preparation period and the impact on the horse sector, without raising checks on the executive.
Why was this bill not simply included in the Tax Plan 2017 at the time, since a longer preparation period would then have been possible?
Waarom is dit wetsvoorstel destijds niet gewoon bij het Belastingplan 2017 meegenomen, aangezien dan een langere voorbereidingstijd was geweest
Calls the abolition a burden on the sector and asks why the proceeds are not reinvested in agriculture, and how the revenue split is justified.
The CDA members ask the government why it did not decide to return the proceeds through an investment in agriculture.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering waarom zij niet besloten heeft de opbrengst terug te geven door middel van een investering in de landbouw
Asks about the effects of the bill on the horse sector and its competitive position relative to Germany and France.
The D66 members ask what the consequences of the bill are for the equestrian sector.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen wat de gevolgen van het wetsvoorstel zijn voor de hippische sector
Asks how many farms use the scheme, whether individual farms face serious losses, and whether a one-year postponement could be given.
What options are there to give farms that use the scheme one year to adapt to it?
Welke mogelijkheden zijn er om boerenbedrijven die gebruik maken van de regeling een jaar de tijd te geven zich daarop aan te passen
Warns that about 21,000 small, mostly older farmers face a clear administrative burden and asks whether a SME test was done and whether the bill can be postponed a year.
Is the government, all things considered, willing to postpone the abolition by at least another year?
Is de regering alles overwegende bereid de afschaffing tenminste nog een jaar uit te stellen
Has strong objections, questions the administrative burden and competitiveness effects, and asks about alternative options such as a flexible flat-rate scheme.
They have major objections to the abolition of the VAT agricultural scheme.
Zij hebben grote bezwaren tegen afschaffing van de btw-landbouwregeling

34845-X.s: This bill amends the 2017 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (Tweede suppletoire begroting), changing spending and commitment appropriations across policy and non-policy articles. It sets budget figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (X) for the year 2017 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Defensie (X) voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34859.s: The bill amends several financial-markets and related laws: it lets the AFM share confidential information with the ACM under consumer protection law, allows the AFM to query the qualifications register via DUO, bars garnishment of funds held at DNB for payment traffic, and extends the bank licence decision period from 13 to 26 weeks. It also makes assorted technical amendments to the Wwft BES, accountants' disciplinary law, bankruptcy and civil procedure provisions, and the Wet houdbare overheidsfinanciën.
34859.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers mainly by efficiency and reduced regulatory burden for supervision and information-sharing, and by the need to align with the ECB's licensing timetable.
q: Extending the decision period for a bank licence application is also partly motivated by the time the ECB needs for decision-making on such applications.

Het verlengen van de beslistermijn voor de aanvraag van een bankvergunning is daarnaast mede ingegeven door de termijn die de ECB nodig heeft voor de besluitvorming ten aanzien van de aanvraag voor een bankvergunning.
p: Allows the AFM to share confidential information with the ACM, departing from the general confidentiality duty, subject to safeguards on secrecy and purpose limitation.
Extends the supervisor's decision period for bank licence applications from 13 to 26 weeks, lengthening the time applicants must wait for a decision.
Bars attachment (derdenbeslag) of goods held by De Nederlandsche Bank for payment systems, removing a creditor remedy against the state-linked central bank with no judicial balancing.
Applies Wet RO complaint procedures to accountants' tribunal members, with the procureur-generaal not obliged to act on requests where the complainant lacks sufficient interest.

parties: Asks how sensitive information shared between AFM and ACM is protected by concrete safeguards, and whether the derdenbeslag ban unduly shields DNB from seizure.
Asks about strategic behaviour by banks, credit effects of the DNB seizure ban, and reasons for lengthening the licence decision period.
What other barriers to entry are there and how can they be removed?
Welke andere toetredingsbarrières zijn er en op welke wijze kunnen deze worden weggenomen?
Asks whether the DNB seizure ban has ever disrupted payments and whether it creates an incentive to store assets at DNB; also asks how AFM savings from DUO data requests will be used.
Furthermore, the CDA members ask whether the ban on third-party seizure at DNB does not create a strong incentive for a financial institution to store as many goods as possible at DNB.

Voorts vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie of er met het verbod op derdenbeslag bij DNB niet een grote prikkel ontstaat voor een financiële instelling om maar zo veel mogelijk goederen bij DNB te stallen.
Stresses proportionality of expanded information exchange against privacy, asks whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens was consulted, and whether data subjects are informed and can appeal.
For that reason the exchange of data must be limited to what is strictly necessary to carry out supervision effectively.
De uitwisseling van gegevens moet zich om die reden beperken tot hetgeen strikt noodzakelijk is om het toezicht effectief uit te voeren.
Asks about the bonus cap, exemptions from it, and the removed remuneration provisions pending evaluation.

Criticises the blanket bonus-cap exemption in the Wft as conflicting with CRD IV guidance, asks for transparency to the Chamber, and asks for justification of the longer licence period and the derdenbeslag ban.
These members ask the government whether this should have consequences for certain undertakings that already fall under the bonus policy under the current regime.
Deze leden vragen de regering of dit consequenties dient te hebben voor bepaalde ondernemingen die onder het huidige regime reeds onder het bonusbeleid vallen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised the Wft amendment bill to proceed to parliament but raised remarks on the compensation regime (delegation basis, bonus cap without transitional law) and on the unclear scope of information sharing between AFM and ACM. The minister's nader rapport moved the compensation provisions out of this bill and clarified the information-sharing rules, and the Afdeling's redactional comments were adopted.
concerns: The delegation basis for rules on fixed remuneration went beyond what the EBA guidelines require and should be narrowed to match the explanatory memorandum; the government removed these provisions from this bill for later legislation.

Immediate entry into force of the bonus cap may infringe the protected right to undisturbed enjoyment of property for existing employment contracts and needs a reasoned justification or a transitional period.
The explanatory memorandum did not clarify which confidential information the AFM may share with the ACM under EU directives, lacking knowability for implementing legislation.
Redactional comments on the bill text were adopted and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens advice reference was added to the explanatory memorandum.

34877.s: The bill temporarily dissolves the Sint Eustatius island council, removes its executive officers, and vests all their powers in a government commissioner appointed by the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations, for gross neglect of duties by the island administration. It sets aside the normal oversight roles of the Rijksvertegenwoordiger and the financial oversight college, and lapses once a new council is seated after elections.
34877.j: The memorandum justifies the measures by the island administration's systematic disregard of oversight procedures and financial rules, which made the normal supervisory instruments ineffective, and follows precedent for municipal gross neglect of duties.
q: It has proven impossible to guide the administration of Sint Eustatius properly using the general and specific supervisory instruments in the WolBES and FinBES.
Het is onmogelijk gebleken om het bestuur op Sint Eustatius in goede banen te leiden met behulp van de algemene en specifieke toezichtinstrumenten die in de WolBES en de FinBES zijn opgenomen.
d: appointment of government commissioner and deputy by royal decree on minister's proposal
government commissioner exercises all powers of island council, executive and governor
minister may issue general and specific instructions to government commissioner
royal decree setting date for island council elections and candidate nomination
budget rules of financial act disapplied; budget deferred
p: Dissolves the elected island council, removes the island executive and appoints a central-government commissioner with the minister as proposer, bypassing elected local government.
Disapplies the Rijksvertegenwoordiger's approval and supervisory powers over the island, removing a check on the executive commissioner.
Disapplies budget and financial oversight rules and the financial oversight college's formal role, with a public inspection step for the draft budget.
Allows the governor to take measures to prevent destruction of island documents on ministerial instruction, with retroactive effect.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Temporary law on gross neglect of duties on Sint Eustatius, which would dissolve the island council and suspend its executive organs in favour of a government commissioner; it accepted the measures as proportionate in principle but asked for more concrete restoration criteria, a graduated transition, a role for the Rijksvertegenwoordiger and Cft, and deletion of the minister's appointment power over the island secretary. The government's nader rapport accepted most points, amended the explanatory memorandum and bill (e.g. deleting article 2(6)), and rejected or only partly adopted the suggestion of a general coordination provision and the removal of the autonomy discussion.
concerns: The Afdeling accepted the intervention as proportionate given the seriousness of the situation but asked for the justification to be strengthened and the duration kept as short as possible.

The Afdeling asked for concrete criteria for when the exceptional regime ends and for a clear, graduated transition back to regular arrangements; the government added some points but refused to specify criteria in detail.

The Afdeling held that the deviation from the four-year council term cannot rest on article 59 of the Constitution and must be read in light of the electoral provisions; the explanatory memorandum was adjusted accordingly.

The Afdeling asked that the Rijksvertegenwoordiger and Cft stay involved during the intervention; the government agreed to inform and consult them where needed but declined to impose detailed statutory obligations.
The Afdeling advised deleting the minister's power to appoint the island secretary and adding a reference to article 232 WolBES to the preamble; these were largely adopted.

The Afdeling asked for a general coordination provision for the Minister of BZK over Caribbean Netherlands; the government declined as ill-suited to this temporary bill, though it promised to reconsider later.

34886.s: The bill amends the 2018 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by an incidental supplementary budget, adding about 98 million euros in expenditure and shifting amounts across articles. It sets the amount unit as thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 16 February 2018, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science for 2018.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

34950-III.s: This supplementary budget act (Slotwet) adjusts the 2017 budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, the Commission for the Intelligence and Security Services, and the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie. The changes record realised spending that was below the budgeted amounts for the year.
q: The surplus is explained by the new Intelligence and Security Services Act not entering into force in 2017 and by incomplete staffing during the year.
Het overschot wordt verklaard door het niet in 2017 in werking treden van de nieuwe Wet op de Inlichtingen en Veiligheidsdiensten en een niet volledige personele bezetting gedurende het jaar.

34958.s: The bill seeks parliamentary approval for a 1960 secret exchange of letters and a 1981 exchange of notes between the Netherlands and the United States on protecting classified information, both amended by the 2017 and 2018 treaty texts. It sets entry into force on the first day of the third calendar month after publication in the Staatsblad.
34958.j: The memorandum explains that the treaties were secret under the former Article 62 Constitution and were not previously submitted to parliament, and that the government considers they contain no provisions binding on individuals under Articles 93 and 94.
q: In the government's view, the treaties contain no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of Articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution that directly grant rights or impose obligations on legal subjects.

Naar het oordeel van de regering bevatten de verdragen geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van artikel 93 en 94 Grondwet, die aan rechtssubjecten rechtstreeks rechten toekennen of plichten opleggen.

parties: Asks which criteria determine whether a treaty needs secrecy or whether that secrecy can be lifted.
The VVD members would like to know which criteria play a role in determining whether a secret character is necessary or can be lifted.
De leden van de VVD-fractie willen graag weten welke criteria een rol spelen bij het bepalen of een geheim karakter nodig is, dan wel opgeheven kan worden.
Asks about the scope of the related defence agreements, the investigation of suspected leaks of classified data, and the agreement's application to the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
How often in the past ten years has there been an investigation into suspicions of illegal provision or loss of classified data on the Dutch and American side?

Hoe vaak is er in de afgelopen tien jaar sprake geweest van het onderzoeken van verdenkingen van het illegaal verstrekken of kwijtraken van gerubriceerde gegevens van Nederlandse en Amerikaanse zijde?
Questions the vague legal test for secret treaties, why declassification came so late, whether the government reviews secrecy regularly, and the legal consequences of wrongful classification.

The phrase that approval is not required 'in exceptional cases of a compelling nature where the interest of the Kingdom makes it absolutely necessary that the treaty have a secret or confidential character' leaves much room for interpretation.
