De zinsnede dat goedkeuring niet vereist is «indien in buitengewone gevallen van dwingende aard het belang van het Koninkrijk het bepaald noodzakelijk maakt dat het verdrag een geheim of vertrouwelijk karakter draagt», laat immers veel ruimte open voor interpretatie.
Asks why the Caribbean public bodies of the Kingdom would be excluded from the agreement's scope, given they are fully part of the Netherlands.
It is not clear to these members why these islands would remain excluded from its operation.
Het is deze leden niet duidelijk waarom deze eilanden van de werking hiervan uitgezonderd zouden blijven.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advises proceeding with the bill approving two classified-information exchange treaties with the United States, but asks the explanatory memorandum to justify the exclusive application to European Netherlands and address the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, notably the BES islands. The government reply states the explanatory memorandum has been adjusted in response to the Council's remark.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum does not explain why the treaties apply only to European Netherlands, and this was requested to be justified and addressed in the text.
It is doubtful whether a strict distinction between European Netherlands and the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom is workable for state secrets, especially given the BES islands' status since 2010.

34967.s: The bill extends paid birth leave for the partner of the mother from four to six weeks and adds five weeks of supplementary birth leave, paid by the employee insurance agency UWV at 70% of daily wage for up to five weeks, within six months after birth. It also removes the possibility of deviating to the employee's disadvantage through collective agreements for birth leave and related provisions, and extends adoption and foster leave.
34967.j: The memorandum justifies the no-deviation rule by the government's commitment to the bill's goals of bonding, fairer work-care division and women's labour participation, and justifies the amvb on daily wage by variations such as shorter employment periods.
q: The Employee Insurance Agency may set control rules. These rules may not go further than strictly necessary for the proper implementation of this article.
Het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen kan controlevoorschriften vaststellen. Deze voorschriften mogen niet verder gaan dan strikt noodzakelijk is voor de juiste uitvoering van dit artikel
d: setting and revising daily wage rules for supplementary birth leave benefit
UWV control provisions for benefit claims
p: UWV may set control rules for benefit claims, which must not go beyond what is strictly necessary for proper implementation.

parties: Asks how the bill achieves its goals, the employer administrative burden of the employer-mediated claim process, and the flexibility and effects of the leave.
The VVD members draw attention to the administrative burden this system imposes on employers.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hierbij aandacht voor de administratieve lasten die deze systematiek met zich meebrengt voor werkgevers.
Supports the extension of birth leave but asks whether low-income employees below the social minimum were considered for supplementary measures and about the link with EU policy.
They are convinced that this bill can make a positive contribution to the bond between the partner (usually the father) and the child.
Zij zijn er van overtuigd dat dit wetsvoorstel een positieve bijdrage kan leveren aan de ontwikkeling van de band tussen de partner (meestal de vader) bij de zorg voor het kind.

Welcomes the bill as a step toward equal sharing of care and work, but asks about low-income groups falling below the social minimum, the employer's power to alter leave for business interests, and the evaluation.
These members ask whether it is known to what extent employers invoke this provision and whether it could hinder taking the leave.
Genoemde leden vragen of bekend is in welke mate werkgevers zich beroepen op deze bepaling en of het een belemmering kan vormen om het verlof op te nemen.
Welcomes the extension but argues one week of full pay is insufficient and asks about the position of self-employed workers and the cost of four weeks at full pay.
These members believe that one week of fully paid birth leave is not enough for that.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat een week volledig betaald geboorteverlof daarvoor niet genoeg is.
Regrets the 70% benefit rather than 100%, the risk that around 4,000 workers fall below the social minimum, and the financing via the Aof premium.
The SP members regret that the benefit is kept at 70% of the daily wage rather than 100%.
De leden van de SP-fractie betreuren het dat vastgehouden wordt aan een uitkering van 70% van het dagloon in plaats van 100%.

Calls the five-week duration a first step but asks why the SER advice for six weeks of paid parental leave was not followed, and asks about excluding self-employed and mothers and households falling below the social minimum.
The PvdA members are very concerned about the group of parents who would fall below the social minimum if they used the additional birth leave.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie maken zich grote zorgen over de groep ouders die als zij gebruik willen maken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof onder het sociaal minimum terecht komen.
Welcomes extension but asks about the two-tier effect between lower and higher income families, the exclusion of self-employed, and earlier monitoring.
These members ask whether earlier monitoring and evaluation would not be desirable, since it is important to map early any barriers.
Deze leden vragen of eerdere monitoring en evaluatie niet gewenst is, aangezien het van belang is om vroegtijdig in kaart te brengen welke eventuele belemmeringen er zijn.
Asks about the child's interests versus labour participation goals, the complexity of overlapping leave schemes, and the misalignment with calamity leave and the EU directive.
These members ask how the bill's objective can be reconciled with the interests of the child.
Deze leden vragen hoe de doelstelling van het wetsvoorstel te rijmen is met de belangen van het kind.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the Wet invoering extra geboorteverlof may proceed, but that its reasoning should better justify the limited effectiveness of the 70% additional parental benefit for workers near the minimum wage. The government's nader rapport reports that the explanatory memorandum was expanded on lower-income workers and that the evaluation will address their uptake, so the advice was followed.
concerns: The Afdeling considers the 70% benefit likely to be of limited effectiveness for low-income workers and asks the explanatory memorandum to address this and the evaluation to pay attention to it.

34976.s: The bill amends the Dutch Caribbean Code of Criminal Procedure (Sv BES) to align special investigative powers with the regime in Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten, adding notification duties, data retention and destruction rules, shorter authorisation periods, and procedural formalities. It also makes minor changes to the Criminal Code BES and the Police Data Act for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
34976.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the need for uniform rules across the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom and for legal practice, and cites compliance with ECHR Articles 6, 8 and 13 for notification and destruction duties.
q: It is however important that citizens know at some point that their fundamental rights are being restricted, because otherwise they cannot submit the justification of this restriction to a court.

Het is echter van belang dat burgers op enig moment weten dat hun grondrechten worden beperkt, omdat zij anders niet de mogelijkheid hebben de gegrondheid van deze grondrechtenbeperking aan de rechter voor te leggen
d: Artikel I, E (177h lid 6 nieuw, lid 4 nieuw)
technical means for executing covert orders
rules on storage, destruction and notification of data obtained by special powers
p: Introduces notification to persons subject to special powers and obligations to destroy or restrict use of data, strengthening citizens' protection.

Expands the scope of covert observation and communication interception to offences that are 'presumably' committed, and permits entry into non-residential premises without owner consent, though prior authorisation by the Procureur-Generaal is required for certain observation.
Allows the public prosecutor to order and modify covert measures orally, subject to written confirmation within three days on pain of nullity and rechter-commissaris authorisation.

parties: Asks whether the government has examined other undesirable omissions in the WvSv BES beyond the identified sexual-offence gap.
Has the government examined whether there are more undesirable omissions in the WvSv BES?
Heeft zij onderzocht of er meer onwenselijke omissies bestaan in het WvSv BES?
Asks why the Procureur-Generaal set aside his earlier, extensive objections and advised positively in 2016, and whether those objections were actually resolved.
Can the government explain what led the Procureur-Generaal to revise his substantive advice on nearly all of the previously raised objections?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten wat de Procureur-Generaal ertoe bewogen heeft zijn inhoudelijke advies op vrijwel alle, eerder geuite, bedenkingen te herzien?

34985.s: The bill integrates the nature protection rules of the Wet natuurbescherming into the Omgevingswet, adding nature objectives, new national and provincial nature areas, and detailed national rules on hunting, species, invasive species, timber and trade. It shifts much of the normative detail from statute to general administrative orders (AMvB) and ministerial rules, while retaining parliamentary pre-consultation for certain designations and giving the Minister new powers to restrict access, impose measures and require landowners to tolerate interventions.
34985.j: The memorandum justifies the broad delegation to general administrative orders by the Omgevingswet's design of keeping only main elements in statute and by the need to honour Europe and international nature obligations.
q: Within the Omgevingswet system it was chosen to regulate only certain main matters at statute level.
Binnen het stelsel van de Omgevingswet is er namelijk voor gekozen om enkel bepaalde hoofdzaken op wetsniveau te regelen
d: allocation of national nature tasks to ministers
mandatory content of national instruction rules on nature
national rules on nature activities, hunting, weapons, whales, exotics, timber, trade, flora and fauna
ministerial deviation from permit activity rules within set limits
rules on faunabeheereenheden and faunabeheerplannen; ministerial competence to decide approval
hunting unit membership rules, provincial ordinance rules
exceptions on shorter hunting lease periods
maximum amount for third-party liability insurance for firearms
entry and tolerance of land for nature measures and population control
designation of organisation collecting fees for controls
designation of species eligible for compensation for wildlife damage
maximum administrative fines for trade violations
administrative measures on illegally traded animals and plants, cost recovery rules
parts of nature designated for monitoring
parliamentary pre-consultation before designating Natura 2000 areas in the EEZ
p: The Minister may designate special national nature areas and restrict or prohibit access to them, including where a province would otherwise hold the power, with the entitlement shifting in some cases by general order.
Landowners must tolerate nature measures by the province or minister, with notice of at least four weeks except in urgent cases where notice may be oral and without time limit.
Persons controlling animal or plant populations may enter private land, with landowners obliged to tolerate them and notice of only 48 hours or orally in urgent cases.
Withdrawal of firearm-activity permits on misuse or doubtful suitability is specified as a ground, with administrative appeal to the Minister of Justice and Security.
The minister may order immediate measures including forced return, seizure, or release to nature at the owner's cost, without prior court involvement.
The minister can impose administrative fines for trade violations, with maximum amounts set by general order and no criminal summary penalty allowed.

parties: Asks how the national government will fill its regulatory role, how knowledge is safeguarded at national level, and whether the Benelux agreement requires more species on the game list.
Does the government agree that, as a result, more species should qualify for inclusion on the game list?
Deelt de regering de mening dat naar aanleiding hiervan meerdere soorten in aanmerking moeten komen voor plaatsing op de wildlijst?
Asks whether the general coordination duty in Omgevingswet article 2.2 provides enough structure for cooperation between levels of government on nature measures.
These members ask whether this general duty provides sufficient structure for cooperation and coordination on the various specific aspects of the nature conservation act.
Deze leden vragen of deze algemene opdracht voldoende structuur biedt voor samenwerking en afstemming ten aanzien van de verschillende specifieke facetten van de natuurbeschermingswet

Worries that moving substantive rules into the implementing decree weakens legal certainty and democratic control, and asks for exemptions for drinking water to be clearly justified with extra safeguards.
Can the government explain whether activities to guarantee public drinking water supply can be exempted from the ban on activities in Natura 2000 areas?
Kan de regering toelichten of activiteiten om de openbare drinkwatervoorziening te garanderen uitgezonderd kunnen worden van het verbod op activiteiten in Natura 2000-gebieden
Fears that discretion at local level and loss of clarity will weaken national oversight of nature protection and international obligations, and asks that general requirements be explicitly included.
These members fear that oversight of national nature protection will not receive the required attention and will fail to meet international obligations.
vrezen deze leden dat de controle op de nationale natuurbescherming niet de vereiste aandacht zal krijgen en niet zal voldoen aan internationale verplichtingen

Asks whether shifting provisions to the explanatory memorandum serves legal certainty and democratic legitimacy, and how democratic control is kept when the general administrative measure is introduced.
These members ask whether this will benefit legal certainty and democratic legitimacy.
Deze leden vragen of dit de rechtszekerheid en democratische legitimiteit ten goede gaat komen.
Asks about the degree of quantification for favourable conservation status and whether the gans should be added to the game list with a transitional arrangement.
Is the assumption correct that this quantification depends heavily on underlying assumptions and references, and therefore the risk of arbitrariness is lurking?
Is de veronderstelling juist dat deze kwantificering in grote mate afhankelijk is van onderliggende aannames en referenties, en derhalve het risico van willekeur op de loer ligt?
Asks the government to respond to proposals to add grey goose, shelduck, roe deer, red deer, fallow deer and wild boar to the national game list and to state whether this is desirable.

The VVD members ask the government to respond extensively to these proposals, the advantages named, and to state whether it considers it desirable to extend the national game list with the mentioned species.

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen de regering uitgebreid te reageren op deze voorstellen, de genoemde voordelen hiervan, en hierbij aan te geven of zij het inderdaad wenselijk acht de nationale wildlijst uit te breiden met voornoemde soorten.

Asks why the natura 2000 area designation cannot follow the municipal nature vision approach, and questions whether the wider discretion for administrative bodies is justified under the Omgevingswet's integrated balancing.
The administrative bodies concerned will indeed receive more room for weighing, among other things through the introduction of a legal mixing panel with bandwidths.
De betrokken bestuursorganen krijgen immers meer afwegingsruimte, onder andere door de introductie van een juridisch mengpaneel met bandbreedtes.

Argues the rules in the Besluit kwaliteit leefomgeving weaken protection of the Natuurnetwerk Nederland compared with the Barro, and asks for additional safeguards in the regulation to prevent this policy weakening.
Is the government willing to include additional safeguards in the regulations to prevent a weakening of policy?
Is de regering bereid om aanvullende waarborgen in de regelgeving op te nemen om een beleidsafzwakking te voorkomen?

Opposes further decentralisation of nature policy to provinces and municipalities without safeguards, and asks what guarantees prevent short-term economic interests overriding EU conservation obligations and whether authorities have capacity to monitor.
These members do not consider it justified that the implementation of nature policy, given an ongoing disaster such as the biodiversity crisis, is entrusted to provinces and municipalities.
Deze leden vinden het niet te rechtvaardigen dat de uitvoering van het natuurbeleid, gezien een voortschrijdende ramp als de biodiversiteitscrisis, wordt belegd bij provincies en gemeenten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill transferring nature protection (Wet natuurbescherming) into the Omgevingswet, requesting clarification of the interaction between nature regimes and municipal environmental plans and justification of the altered competence structure. The government's reply accepted most points by adding explanatory text, revising provisions, and moving some rules to lower-level regulation, while keeping the core structure.
concerns: The Afdeling requested clearer explanation of how the nature protection regime interacts with the municipal environmental plan and its consequences, which the government addressed by adding a general discussion in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling found it insufficiently justified that the detailed statutory competence and consultation structure for nature protection is replaced by a general coordination provision, and asked for safeguards maintaining an equivalent protection level.
The Afdeling made several redactional suggestions, most of which the government adopted in the bill and explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling noted that allocation of ministerial tasks for Natura 2000 areas is better placed in an algemene maatregel van bestuur than in the statute, which the government adopted.

34994.s: The bill amends the Civil Code, Jeugdwet, Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning, Wet verplichte geestelijke gezondheidszorg and Wet zorg en dwang to strengthen patients' informed consent, extend medical record retention to twenty years, and regulate access to records of deceased patients. Access for relatives is limited to specified grounds such as a serious interest, with the healthcare provider or court deciding whether that interest is shown.
34994.j: The memorandum justifies the access rules by balancing relatives' legitimate interests against patient privacy and professional secrecy, and notes that the courts can decide disputes.
q: Only once the healthcare provider or the judge has found that a serious interest exists and that access is necessary to protect that interest does the relative have a right of access.
Pas als de hulpverlener of de rechter heeft geoordeeld dat sprake is van een zwaarwegend belang en de inzage noodzakelijk is voor de behartiging van dat belang, heeft de nabestaande recht op inzage.
p: Relatives' access to deceased patients' records is conditioned on a serious interest and assessed by the healthcare provider or a judge, which limits discretion over disclosure.

parties: Asks how compliance with the shared decision-making duty will be ensured, including whether the Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd will supervise it.
These members ask the government how it is ensured that healthcare providers actually engage in the conversation with their patient.
Deze leden vragen de regering op welke wijze wordt geborgd dat hulpverleners ook daadwerkelijk het gesprek aangaan met hun patiënt.

Questions the removal of presumed consent for relatives' inspection, warning of formalisation and juridification, and asks for reasons behind the twenty-year retention period and the exceptions to record destruction.

Said members ask whether the government acknowledges the risk that this creates unnecessary formalisation and juridification, with adverse consequences for the patient, their relatives and the physician.
Genoemde leden vragen of de regering het risico erkent dat hiermee onnodige formalisering en juridisering ontstaat, met nadelige gevolgen voor de patiënt, zijn nabestaanden en de arts.

Asks who decides whether a relative has a weighty interest, how conflicts between relatives and providers are resolved, and whether an independent third party can be consulted; also questions loss of room to follow the patient's wishes.
These members ask who makes the assessment of whether there is a weighty interest.
Deze leden vragen wie de afweging maakt of er sprake is van een zwaarwegend belang.
Asks whether the new threshold for relatives' inspection is higher than current practice and how the 'weighty interest' ground applies, including to journalists or whistleblowers.

These members ask whether the current proposal, which requires a notification of an incident by the care provider or a weighty interest, raises a higher threshold for relatives to request inspection than current practice.

Deze leden vragen of het huidige voorstel, waarin sprake moet zijn van een mededeling over een incident van de zorgaanbieder of een zwaarwegend belang, een grotere drempel opwerpt voor de nabestaanden om een verzoek tot inzage te doen dan in de huidige praktijk.

Questions the privacy trade-offs, who weighs competing interests when a provider may be implicated, the scope of the 'weighty interest' examples, and why the Jeugdwet lacks an incident-reporting regime.
Who makes that weighing, ask these members.
Wie maakt die weging, zo vragen deze leden.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory board recommends proceeding with a bill on patient information duties, extended record retention and next-of-kin access to deceased patients' records, but asks for justification or amendment where the proposal departs from current case law, notably on presumed consent and on the scope of next-of-kin. The government's nader rapport accepts most points: it clarifies the explanatory memorandum, drops the 'presumed consent' ground in favour of incident and serious-interest grounds, opens the serious-interest category to any next-of-kin, and adopts the KNMG point that records are destroyed only on written or electronic request.
concerns: The Afdeling asks for clarity on how the proposed access grounds relate to current case law, including presumed consent, and the government clarifies the memorandum and deliberately departs from case law.
The Afdeling says that the next-of-kin category should follow the Wkkgz definition rather than a closed list, and the government removes the closed list.
The Afdeling asks what follows when a patient has recorded refusal of access and a next-of-kin has a serious interest, and the government clarifies that the patient's written wish prevails.
The Afdeling endorses the KNMG proposal that records are destroyed only on a written or electronic request from the patient, and the government adopts it.
The Afdeling makes detailed redactional comments on the wording of the information duty, which the government incorporates.

35000-VII.s: The bill fixes the 2019 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations and the operating budgets of its executive agencies, in thousands of euros. It sets the budget figures for policy articles on democracy, housing, energy, spatial planning, and government services, with the memorandum describing policy priorities and budget flexibility.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this law for the year 2019 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35450-IV.s: This first supplementary budget for 2020 amends the budget statements for Kingdom Relations and the BES fund, shifting funds such as reconstruction money for Sint Maarten and Sint Eustatius and rule-of-law amounts. The bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power; it adjusts appropriations and sets an effective date retroactive to 1 May 2020.
q: Amendment of the budget statement for Kingdom Relations and of the budget statement of the BES fund, both for the year 2020.
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat Koninkrijksrelaties en van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds, alle voor het jaar 2020.

35450-VI.s: This first supplementary budget for 2020 amends the departmental budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budgets of its executive agencies (DJI, IND, CJIB, NFI, Justis) by increasing expenditure and receipts across policy articles. The bill itself contains no delegations or changes to institutional checks; it adjusts budget figures and cash-flow allocations, and the explanatory memorandum describes mainly budget shifts and reallocations.
q: These include, among others, a cash shift for an early retirement scheme for the police, a cash shift at DJI to cover friction costs, and a cash shift in legal aid for temporary extra funds for social advocacy.

Het betreft onder ander een kasschuif op een vroegpensioenregeling van de politie (inkoop Max), een kasschuif bij DJI ter dekking van frictiekosten en een kasschuif bij rechtsbijstand voor tijdelijk extra middelen sociale advocatuur.

35489.s: The bill changes the procedure for establishing election results under the Kieswet, introducing municipal counting boards that check and correct polling-station records in public sessions, and allowing municipalities to opt for central vote counting. It also makes related technical amendments to the Kieswet, the Waterschapswet, the Mediawet 2008, and the Mediawet BES, and repeals the experimental-law basis for central counting.
35489.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to make the result procedure transparent and correctable and to leave room for locally tailored counting methods.
q: The bill provides that the college of mayor and aldermen of every municipality establishes a municipal counting board for every election.
Het wetsvoorstel regelt dat het college van burgemeester en wethouders van elke gemeente 2 voor elke verkiezing een gemeentelijk stembureau instelt.
d: composition and procedure of municipal and central counting boards, transport boxes and storage of ballots
model for application form and replacement postal ballot
models for minutes of counting boards and corrigenda
rules on publication, inspection and transfer of minutes and digital files
p: Municipal counting boards may reopen and recount sealed ballot packages and correct polling-station records when suspected errors are found.
Ministers and municipal executives are empowered to establish postal ballot counting boards and set their size.

parties: Asks whether the municipal electoral board and the role of the mayor remain clear, whether digital checks on counting errors exist, and why the registration period for postal votes is extended.
What possibilities are there to use digital tools when calculating the result?
Welke mogelijkheden zijn er om digitale hulpmiddelen in te zetten bij het berekenen van de uitslag?
Asks when the separate bill on digital aids will be submitted and whether the 2021 entry-into-force date is still feasible, given the open question of responsibility for digital tools.
When will the intended bill be submitted to the House, these members ask.
Wanneer zal het bedoelde wetsvoorstel bij de Kamer worden ingediend, zo vragen deze leden.

Supports transparency and correction of errors but questions the practical feasibility for municipalities, the independence of the central and municipal boards, and the cost and discretion around recounts ordered by representative bodies.
Before the members can agree with the proposed arrangement, they need more insight into the number of counting errors in the minutes and the number of unexplained count differences.

Alvorens de leden van de fractie met de voorgestelde regeling kunnen instemmen, hebben zij behoefte aan meer inzicht in aantallen telfouten in de processen verbaal en aantallen niet-verklaarde telverschillen tussen stemmers en stembiljetten.

Asks how differences between municipalities in counting options affect voter trust and who bears the extra costs, and questions the restricted zendtijd and the non-democratic seats for business premises users in water boards.
Can the government explain how this inequality between municipalities contributes to voter trust?
Kan de regering toelichten hoe deze ongelijkheid tussen gemeenten bijdraagt aan het vertrouwen van kiezers?
Asks about the burden on municipalities of mandatory central counting by March 2021 and the coordination with other reform processes, and wants results shared at polling-station level in open data.
Can the government elaborate on these points and on the desirability of a general obligation within the relatively short timeframe up to March 2021?
Kan de regering nader ingaan op deze punten en de wenselijkheid van algemene verplichting op de relatief korte termijn tot maart 2021?
Asks about procedures when the sum of polling-station results differs from the total, how the order of postal votes is determined, and whether the bill clearly describes the Kiesraad's new task.
Why was it not chosen to describe this task more precisely?
Waarom is er niet voor gekozen deze taak nader te omschrijven?

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory opinion of 30 January 2020 on the Kieswet amendment bill (new procedure for establishing election results) accepts most of the bill but raises objections on the identification requirement, the replacement postal ballot and voter pass, abolition of the main polling bureaus, and the Mediawet change for new parties in the BES. The minister's reply of 5 June 2020 adopts the identification point partly, explains the differences in replacement documents, justifies the transition and workload, and defends the Mediawet change while adding explanatory text.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that a copy of an identity document be required in all cases where a voter requests to vote other than in the polling station, including postal voting by Dutch residents abroad; the government adopted this for residents but not for written proxy requests.

The Afdeling asks for reasoned justification for not providing a replacement voter pass while providing a replacement postal ballot; the government explained the administrative burden and the postal-vote problem.

The Afdeling asks that the explanatory memorandum address the increased workload for the central polling bureau and the feasibility of the new results procedure after abolishing the main polling bureaus; the government added explanation but did not add extra capacity or mandate digital tools.

The Afdeling asks for justification and consideration of alternatives for the Mediawet change allowing new parties to obtain broadcast time without supporting declarations in all constituencies, given equal electoral choice for BES residents; the government found the restriction justified and added explanatory text.
The Afdeling's two editorial remarks on cross-references and wording in articles M 5 and N 22 were incorporated into the bill.

35498.s: This bill modernises Dutch civil evidence law to speed up civil procedure: parties must gather and submit relevant information before and at the start of proceedings, with adverse inferences for non-compliance, and the judge gets a clearer role in discussing the factual basis with the parties. It also consolidates pre-trial evidentiary measures into one request for preliminary evidence, widens and conditions the right of inspection of documents, and creates a general conservatory evidence seizure procedure with a proces-verbaal van constateringen by bailiffs.
35498.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as improving efficiency, truth-finding and the quality of civil judgments, and states that the judge's powers are bounded by the rights of the other party and the principle of impartiality.
q: To this end the bill contains the following principles: parties gather as much relevant information about their dispute as possible before a claim is brought to court.

Het wetsvoorstel bevat daartoe de volgende uitgangspunten: – het zoveel mogelijk door partijen verzamelen van de relevante informatie over hun geschil voordat een procedure bij de rechter wordt aangespannen
p: Judges gain broader discretion to draw adverse inferences from non-compliance with disclosure duties and to decide on refusals of information, subject to judicial review of those refusals.
Bailiffs are empowered to draw up evidentiary records of facts they personally observe, which can be used as authentic evidence in civil proceedings without the judge's prior involvement.

A general conservatory evidence seizure is introduced, allowing seizure of documents and data with prior judicial leave, with conditions and a 'double reasonableness' test, and without notification to affected third parties until the main case is decided.

parties: Worries that mandatory pre-trial disclosure and the new judicial role under Article 24 could complicate proceedings, raise costs and deter access to the courts.

The members are concerned that the proposed change could considerably complicate civil proceedings, lead to large additional costs for litigants, and thereby considerably restrict access to the courts for most citizens and small and medium-sized enterprises.

De aan het woord zijnde leden maken zich zorgen dat de voorgestelde stelselwijziging civiele procedures aanzienlijk kan compliceren, kan leiden tot grote extra kosten voor rechtzoekenden, en daarmee de toegang tot de rechter voor de meeste burgers en het midden- en kleinbedrijf (MKB) aanzienlijk kan beperken.
Asks how the expanded pre-trial collection of personal data can be justified and minimised in line with the GDPR, and questions the workload claims.

They think that in particular the proposed phase before a procedure, in which as much information as possible must be gathered, can have a major impact on the collection and processing of personal data.

Zij denken dat met name de voorgestelde fase voorafgaand aan een procedure, waarin zoveel mogelijk informatie verzameld moet worden, een grote impact kan hebben op de verzameling en verwerking van persoonsgegevens.

Doubts that mandatory evidence gathering before proceedings improves access to justice, risks escalation especially in family cases, and fears judges would be flooded with possibly irrelevant material.
These members, after reading this bill, have strong doubts whether the duty to gather evidence before judicial proceedings contributes to promoting access to justice.

Deze leden hebben na het lezen van dit wetsvoorstel sterke twijfels of de plicht tot bewijsvergaring voorafgaand aan de rechterlijke procedure bijdraagt aan de bevordering van de toegang tot het recht.

Supports in principle the extension of inspection rights and evidence seizure but is not convinced the bill achieves efficiency and truth-finding; raises frontloading, the sanction of excluding new evidence, and appeal rights.
But these members are not yet convinced that this bill achieves both objectives.
Maar voornoemde leden zijn er nog niet van overtuigd dat met dit wetsvoorstel beide doelstellingen worden bereikt.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a bill modernising Dutch civil evidence law, raising concerns about the judge's role in fact-finding, the appeal ban for pre-trial evidentiary measures ex parte, and the extension of the family testimony privilege to life partners. The Minister's reply accepts the core of the bill, clarifies the explanatory memorandum on these points, and adjusts the bill and drafting.
concerns: The appeal ban on pre-trial evidentiary measures decided ex parte may conflict with the right to be heard under Article 6 ECHR; the reply clarifies the explanatory memorandum and points to the hearing requirement in Article 195a Rv.

The proposed amendment to Article 24 Rv on the judge's power to discuss the factual basis of claims may add little beyond existing law; the government retained it but clarified its added value in the explanatory memorandum.
The concept of 'levensgezel' for the family testimony privilege needed fuller explanation of the relevant factors; the explanatory memorandum was expanded accordingly.
Redactional comments on Article 165 Rv, Article 190(6) Rv, and the concordance principle were largely adopted, with one exception on Article 190 Rv explained by the government.

35579.s: The bill sets the tariffs for the energy and climate transition surcharge on electricity and natural gas consumption for 2021 and 2022 by amending the Wet opslag duurzame energie- en klimaattransitie. It also raises the amount in the Wet Belastingen op milieugrondslag by specified euro amounts from 2021 and 2022.
q: that it is desirable to set tariffs for the energy and climate transition surcharge on electricity and natural gas consumption for the years 2021 and 2022
dat het wenselijk is tarieven voor de opslag duurzame energie- en klimaattransitie op het verbruik van elektriciteit en aardgas voor de jaren 2021 en 2022 vast te stellen

parties: Asks detailed questions on reserve use, tariff projections, revenue splits and possible changes to the 2022 tariffs, which the government could propose without a full bill.
The VVD members ask why and when the government can propose to still change the tariffs for 2022.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen waarom en wanneer de regering kan voorstellen de tarieven voor 2022 alsnog te wijzigen.
Stresses balance between household and business burdens and asks for justification of differing tariff changes across electricity bands and clarity on use of the reserve.
Can the government provide insight into the expected ODE revenues for 2019–2022 divided over the different sectors?
Kan de regering inzicht geven in de (verwachte) opbrengsten van de ODE van 2019–2022 verdeeld over de verschillende sectoren
Asks about progressivity of the tariff structure, effectiveness, and project delays in the energy transition.
The D66 members ask what the effects of the progressive tariff structure are on the effectiveness of the ODE.
De leden van de fractie van D66 vragen wat de effecten van de progressieve tariefstructuur zijn op de effectiviteit van de ODE.
Disappointed that 680 million euro was transferred from the energy transition reserve to general funds, undermining the promise that ODE money is spent on sustainable energy.
The GroenLinks members are disappointed that 680 million euro has been transferred from the sustainable energy budget reserve to general funds.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zijn teleurgesteld over het feit dat 680 miljoen euro uit de begrotingsreserve duurzame energie is overgeheveld naar de algemene middelen.

Argues households and SMEs bear unfairly the cost of industry's transition, contrary to the polluter-pays principle and a Chamber motion; demands substantive answers and implementation of the Beckerman motion.
They find it incomprehensible that under this system households and SMEs pay for the greening of the most polluting industry.
Zij vinden het onbegrijpelijk dat door dit systeem de huishoudens en het mkb betalen voor de verduurzaming van de meest vervuilende industrie.
Supports shifting burden toward businesses but asks the government to report annually on household energy bills and why top-band tariffs stay unchanged.
They ask the government to report annually with the Tax Plan on the development of household energy bills.
Zij vragen de regering jaarlijks met het Belastingplan te rapporteren over de ontwikkeling van de energierekening voor huishoudens.
Accepts the need for the increase but questions why the fourth band is spared and asks about targeted support and the choice of 'frontrunner' companies.
These members ask the government whether it has considered shifting band 3 to band 4 for electricity ODE.
Deze leden vragen de regering of er is nagedacht over een verschuiving van schijf 3 naar 4
Asks how the tariff increase fits with electrification goals for greenhouse horticulture and why bands three and four are not aligned.
How is that reconciled with the proposed increase of the ODE levy on electricity?
Hoe is dat te rijmen met de voorgestelde verhoging van de ODE-heffing op stroom?

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on a draft bill amending the Wet opslag duurzame energie- en klimaattransitie to set surcharge rates for 2021 and 2022, part of the 2021 tax package. The Afdeling raised no remarks and advised submitting the bill to the House of Representatives, and the minister's reply (nader rapport) notes only an update to the explanatory memorandum and an increase in the energy tax reduction under the Klimaatakkoord.

35597.s: The bill amends the Dutch Copyright Act and the Neighbouring Rights Act to implement EU Directive 2019/789 on online broadcasts and cable retransmission of broadcasts. It redefines cable and other retransmission, requires collective management for retransmission rights, and sets a country-of-origin rule for broadcasters' supporting online services.
35597.j: The memorandum justifies the general administrative order power by saying that the costs of collective exercise are low and can be controlled, and that it allows closer cooperation among collective management organisations to reduce transaction costs.
q: Under Article 45d(5) of the Copyright Act, further rules on the exercise may be given by general administrative order.
Op grond van artikel 45d, vijfde lid, van de Auteurswet kunnen bij algemene maatregel van bestuur namelijk nadere regels worden gegeven met betrekking tot de uitoefening.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel C (art. 26a Auteurswet) / memorie van toelichting
collective exercise of retransmission rights, cooperation among collective management organisations
Artikel I, onderdeel E (art. 45d Auteurswet, vijfde lid)
further rules on collective exercise of the remuneration claim for film authors

parties: Asks about member-state options, how the collectively managed remuneration scheme will work, and how to prevent money being retained by the collective manager.
How is it prevented that money remains stuck in the bow of such a collectively managed remuneration scheme?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat er geld blijft hangen aan de strijkstok van een dergelijk collectief beheerde vergoedingsaanpak?
Asks which circumstances determine the fair remuneration, how collective negotiation with producers works, and what happens if no agreement is reached.
What are the possible next steps if this does not succeed?
Wat zijn mogelijke vervolgstappen als dit niet lukt?
Asks what 'minor' collective management costs means, who will bear them, and in which cases the government will use the AMvB power to set detailed rules.
Can the government concretely indicate in which cases it wants to use this possibility to set further rules by AMvB?
Kan de regering concreet aangeven in welke gevallen zij gebruik wil maken van deze mogelijkheid om bij AMvB nadere regels te geven?
Notes that the interpretation of 'plausible' may ultimately be reserved to the Court of Justice of the EU and asks the government for more clarity.
They consider it important that the term 'plausible' be further clarified, because they can imagine that its interpretation will ultimately be reserved to the Court of Justice of the European Union.

Zij achten het van belang dat de term «aannemelijk» nader wordt verduidelijkt omdat het voor hen denkbaar is dat dat de uitleg hieromtrent uiteindelijk aan het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie is voorbehouden.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Implementatiewet Richtlijn online omroepdiensten amending the Auteurswet and Wet op de naburige rechten to implement EU Directive 2019/789, and found no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister's letter forwards the advice and requests that the bill be sent to parliament, with no separate nader rapport containing substantive replies.

35669.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) through a first supplementary budget, raising spending authorisations and expenditure by about 2.5 billion euro, mainly for labour market measures and the self-employed support scheme (Tozo). It sets the amounts in thousands of euro and makes the change effective from 1 January 2021.
35669.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increase by the higher take-up of the Tozo-3 scheme in 2020, which it expects to continue in 2021.
q: As a result of the higher take-up of Tozo-3 in 2020, it is expected that Tozo use will also be higher in 2021.
Als gevolg van het hogere beroep op Tozo-3 in 2020 is de verwachting dat het Tozo-gebruik in 2021 ook hoger zal liggen.

35678.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget (departmental budget statement) of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport to add funding for COVID-19 measures via a first supplementary budget. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 January 2021.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35687.s: The bill creates a statelessness determination procedure in which the Hague district court, after hearing the State, can declare a person stateless, and a related non-judicial route for evident statelessness. It also amends the Vreemdelingenwet 2000, the Wet basisregistratie personen, and provides for an identification document for stateless foreigners without lawful residence.
35687.j: The memorandum justifies non-judicial determination and the general order on grounds of flexibility, since foreign determinations change over time and evident cases should not burden courts.
q: The conditions for such a non-judicial determination will be further elaborated in a general administrative order.
Aan welke voorwaarden een dergelijke niet-judiciële vaststelling zal moeten voldoen, zal nader worden uitgewerkt in een algemene maatregel van bestuur.
d: conditions for non-judicial determination of evident statelessness
fees (leges) and withdrawal/replacement of identification document
p: Allows the executive to establish statelessness outside a court by general administrative order, bypassing judicial determination in evident cases.

parties: Concerned about possible effects of the procedure and asks how staff and experts are involved in individual cases.

These members understand the procedure the government wants to create to establish statelessness and are positive about the choice not to attach temporary lawful residence to it or to tolerate illegality.

Deze leden hebben begrip voor de procedure die de regering in het leven wil roepen om staatloosheid te kunnen vaststellen en zijn positief over de keuze hier geen tijdelijk rechtmatig verblijf aan te koppelen of illegaliteit bij te gedogen.
Argues that establishment of statelessness should carry lawful residence, as the UNHCR and ACVZ advise, and that the choice not to do so is a political one.
Both the ACVZ and the UNHCR point out that this is incompatible with obligations arising from the 1954 Convention.
Zowel de ACVZ als de UNHCR wijzen erop dat dit strijdig is met de de voortvloeiende verplichtingen uit het 1954-verdrag.
Questions the single factual instance, lack of cassation review of foreign law, and the tie between statelessness and lawful residence, urging more safeguards for applicants.
These members specifically ask why the government assumes no new facts will emerge on appeal, given that statelessness procedures are almost always complex.
Deze leden vragen in het bijzonder waarom de regering er vanuit gaat dat in tweede instantie geen nieuwe feiten naar voren zullen komen.
Questions the single instance, single-judge default, burden of proof on stateless persons, and the absence of an evaluation clause.
How is a stateless person supposed to show that he or she has no nationality?
Hoe moet een staatloze aan kunnen tonen dat hij/zij geen nationaliteit heeft?
Objects that the procedure does not suspend removability and that no lawful residence follows, calling this an overly bureaucratic approach to stateless people.
These members ask why the government does not want to recognise that this is an extremely bureaucratic approach to stateless persons.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering niet wil inzien dat dit een extreem bureaucratische benadering van staatlozen is.
Asks about single-judge treatment as the default, the six-month decision deadline, and the consequences of missed deadlines.
These members understand that the decision period can be extended once by at most six months.
Deze leden begrijpen dat de beslistermijn éénmaal verlengd kan worden met ten hoogste zes maanden.
Worries that credibility findings on asylum stories could wrongly carry over to statelessness claims and asks for clear evidentiary standards.
These members consider this undesirable, since no compelling logical link can be assumed between the credibility of the asylum account and the credibility of the claimed statelessness.

Deze leden achten dit ongewenst, aangezien er geen dwingend logisch verband aangenomen kan worden tussen de geloofwaardigheid van het asielrelaas en de geloofwaardigheid van de gestelde staatloosheid.
Asks about the scale of statelessness, misuse safeguards, and the IND's expertise and consultation on feasibility.
How will the government prevent misuse of this procedure?
Hoe gaat de regering misbruik van deze procedure voorkomen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State supports the proposed statelessness determination procedure but raises objections on residence rights after determination, issuing identity documents to stateless persons without lawful residence, and excluding appeal. The government's nader rapport accepts the identity-document advice by adding a statutory basis for a pass, rejects the residence-right and appeal objections with reasons, and notes that the single-instance route is justified.
concerns: Absence of any residence right after statelessness determination; the Afdeling asked for a real and effective route to a residence permit for stateless persons who cannot leave through no fault of their own, and the reply relies on the existing buitenschuld policy with only the added evidentiary value of the determination.

Article 27 of the 1954 Convention requires identity papers for stateless persons regardless of residence status; the Afdeling advised a statutory basis for such documents, which the government adopted by adding a pass for determined stateless persons without lawful residence.

Exclusion of appeal (single factual instance) in tension with the need for fact-finding and foreign-law assessment; the Afdeling asked for a reasoned justification, which the government gave while not accepting the Raad voor de Rechtspraak's proposal for a Gerechtshof appeal.

35696.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science by a second supplementary budget, mainly to fund extra devices for remote education in primary and secondary schools in connection with COVID-19. It sets the budget amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect from 6 January 2021, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2021
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2021

35759.s: The bill amends the Politiewet 2012 to add guarding and securing objects and services to police tasks, and to restructure assistance arrangements between police, the Koninklijke marechaussee and other armed forces units so that the Minister of Justice and Security decides on assistance and can issue instructions. It also changes budget, annual accounts and management plan procedures so the police chief drafts them under the Minister's authority.
35759.j: The memorandum justifies the new ministerial powers by the structural police demand for marechaussee assistance and the need for clear management relations, and says the Minister's instruction power is a normal, low-threshold steering instrument.
q: To meet this need, the capacity of the Koninklijke marechaussee has been expanded since 2015 with six platoons focused on guarding and securing objects and services.
Om aan deze behoefte te kunnen voldoen is de capaciteit van de Koninklijke marechaussee sinds 2015 uitgebreid met zes pelotons, gericht op de bewaking en beveiliging van objecten en diensten.
d: rules or policy rules on use of police powers by other armed forces units in special cases
rules or policy rules on use of powers by other armed forces units assisting marechaussee
general and specific directions to officers assisting national units
Minister decides deployment of special assistance units and may give directions to personnel
p: Regional authority may ask the Minister to order the police chief to provide assistance the chief refused, bypassing the police chief's decision.
ARTIKEL I I (Art. 57 en 58, Art. 61 en 62)
Assistance requests from regional authorities to the marechaussee and other armed forces are now decided by the national Minister, shifting decisions away from local authorities and the police chief.
The police chief drafts budget, annual accounts and management plan that the Minister adopts, with the accountant's statement on the accounts retained.

parties: Asks what concrete powers the chief constable gains and whether this means more autonomy while remaining under ministerial authority.
What powers or possibilities does the chief constable gain that he did not have before, or for which permission from the Minister was previously required?
Welke bevoegdheden of mogelijkheden krijgt de korpschef die hij eerst niet had of waarvoor in enige vorm toestemming van de Minister moest worden verkregen?
Asks whether the governing authority (gezag) would be able to make an assistance request itself to the chief constable.
Can the government explain whether, under this bill, the governing authority would be given the possibility to make an assistance request to the chief constable itself?
Kan de regering toelichten of het gezag met dit wetsvoorstel de mogelijkheid zou krijgen zelf een bijstandsverzoek te doen aan de korpschef?

Points to the gap between ministerial responsibility and the budget and accountability arrangement with the police, asking for detailed budget chapters and full integration of the police budget into the departmental budget.

These members believe that the Minister's powers call for a detailed elaboration of the police budget within the budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security, with accompanying extensive accountability to parliament.

Deze leden zijn van mening dat de bevoegdheden van de Minister vragen om een gedetailleerde uitwerking van de begroting van de politie in de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, met de daarbij behorende uitgebreide verantwoording richting het parlement.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering advised on a bill amending the Politiewet 2012 to strengthen the position of the chief constable, asking the explanatory memorandum to explain how greater local tailoring will be achieved within existing legal frameworks. The government's reply accepts the observation, sharpens the explanatory memorandum accordingly, and adopts the one drafting remark.
concerns: The Afdeling notes the changes have limited scope and asks the explanatory memorandum to explain how more local tailoring will be achieved within existing legal frameworks, which the government followed by sharpening the memorandum.
The Afdeling suggests deleting the word 'nodige' in article 43(3) or explaining the deviation from comparable articles, which the government adopted.

35786.s: The bill proposes a new unnumbered general provision inserted before Chapter 1 of the Dutch Constitution, stating that the Constitution guarantees fundamental rights and the democratic constitutional state. The explanatory memorandum is a short excerpt noting that it is the second reading of a constitutional amendment following the 2018 declaratory act and refers to earlier parliamentary papers.
q: The Constitution guarantees the fundamental rights and the democratic constitutional state.
De Grondwet waarborgt de grondrechten en de democratische rechtsstaat.

parties: Welcomes the wording and the order of fundamental rights before the democratic rule of law; has no questions for the government.
The bill gives these members no reason to put questions to the government.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft deze leden geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen aan de regering.
Sees enshrining the core principles in the Constitution as a step forward given recent rule-of-law failures; has no further questions.
As far as these members are concerned, it is a step forward to enshrine these core principles in the Constitution.
Wat deze leden betreft is het een stap vooruit deze kernbeginselen vast te leggen in de Grondwet.
Asks what normative effect the clause adds and how it relates to constitutional review by courts.
These members explicitly ask the government to address the relationship between constitutional review and a general clause guaranteeing fundamental rights and the democratic rule of law.

Deze leden vragen de regering daarbij uitdrukkelijk in te gaan op de verhouding tussen constitutionele toetsing en vormen van een algemene bepaling waarin de grondrechten en de democratische rechtsstaat worden gewaarborgd.
Asks who is addressed by the clause, whether it binds all state powers now, and how it fits with the ban on judicial review of the Constitution.
The question does arise, however, of how this duty relates to the prohibition on judges reviewing the Constitution in Article 120.
Wel rijst de vraag hoe deze opdracht zich verhoudt tot het verbod aan de rechter om aan de Grondwet te toetsen in artikel 120 van de Grondwet.
Asks whether the review ban in Article 120 helps or hinders the protection of fundamental rights.

The ChristenUnie members ask the government whether Article 120, the review ban, contributes to safeguarding fundamental rights and the democratic rule of law, or whether it may instead be an obstacle.}

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen aan de regering of artikel 120 van de Grondwet, het toetsingsverbod, bijdraagt aan de borging van grondrechten en de democratische rechtsstaat, of hier juist een belemmering in kan zijn.
Asks for the scope of rights covered and the criteria for distinguishing fundamental rights from human rights not in the Constitution.
These members ask the government what the scope is of the fundamental rights covered by the general clause.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering wat de reikwijdte is van de grondrechten die door de algemene bepaling worden bestreken.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a proposed constitutional amendment adding a general provision, and made no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply confirms the bill is sent to parliament, with no substantive points raised by the Raad to answer.

35850-III.s: The bill amends the 2021 budget statements for the Ministry of General Affairs, the Cabinet of the King, and the Commission for the Oversight of the Intelligence and Security Services, via a first supplementary budget. It also adjusts the budget of the Dienst Publiek en Communicatie agency and sets the entry into force.
q: Amendment of the 2021 budget statement of the Ministry of General Affairs (IIIA) (First supplementary budget)
Wijziging begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken (IIIA) voor het jaar 2021 (Eerste suppletoire begroting)

35858.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2019/1160 on cross-border distribution of collective investment undertakings by amending the Wft to add rules on pre-marketing, notification and de-notification procedures for fund managers, and reporting of changes. It makes the AFM responsible for notifications to foreign supervisors and sets timelines for AFM responses and information transfers.
35858.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as necessary implementation of the EU directive and does not justify any delegation or new executive powers.
q: This bill amends the Financial Supervision Act (Wft) to implement Directive (EU) 2019/1160.
Dit wetsvoorstel strekt tot wijziging van de Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft) ter implementatie van de richtlijn (EU) 2019/1160

parties: Asks what the new framework will mean for the Dutch fund market and how a level playing field is ensured for managers depending on their home and target member states.
Can the government indicate how a level playing field is guaranteed as far as possible in this respect?
Kan de regering aangeven hoe in dezen het gelijke speelveld zoveel mogelijk gewaarborgd wordt?
Asks about the negative effects of pre-marketing rules, the regulatory burden on investment institutions, and whether supervisory costs will rise or fall.
The PVV members also want to know to what extent supervisory costs will increase or decrease as a result of this bill.
Tevens willen de leden van de PVV-fractie weten in hoeverre de toezichtkosten zullen toe- of afnemen als gevolg van dit wetsvoorstel.

Questions whether a framework for complex financial products should come first, notes low public trust in financial markets, and asks for clear definitions of pre-marketing and the scope of the rules.
The SP members ask the government whether a framework should first be created for UCITS with the question of how to deal with complex financial products.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering of eerst niet een kader geschapen moet worden voor icbe's met de vraag hoe om te gaan met complexe financiële producten.
Asks what effects the new framework will have on the Dutch fund market and whether Dutch providers will expand into other EU member states.
what effects it expects from the new legal framework for the Dutch investment fund market.
welke gevolgen zij verwacht van het nieuwe wettelijk kader voor de Nederlandse markt voor beleggingsfondsen

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised, on 28 April 2021, that it had no comments on the draft bill implementing EU Directive 2019/1160 on cross-border distribution of UCITS and AIFs, and recommended submitting it to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 31 May 2021 transmits this advice to the King and the bill.

35894.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate for 2021, implementing the eighth incidental supplementary budget with additional support for events and mental support for entrepreneurs. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 19 July 2021 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en Klimaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35925-X.s: This bill formally establishes the 2022 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Defence (about €11.6 billion in expenditure appropriations) and the 2022 budget statement for the Paresto agency, which has zero net balance. It also sets amounts in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 January 2022 with retroactive effect where publication is later.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on 13 September 2021, that it had no remarks on the draft Defence budget act (begrotingsstaat Defensie) for 2022 and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance, on behalf of the Minister of Defence, replied in a nader rapport of 20 September 2021 that some budgets required amendments, referring to annexes.

35957.s: The bill creates statutory delegation powers allowing the government to adopt, by general administrative order (AMvB), additional compensation schemes for victims of the childcare and other benefits scandal, covering institutional bias, unfair debt recovery refusals, and related recovery and assessment adjustments. It sets a four-week parliamentary pre-consultation period on each draft order, with a right for one chamber or a fifth of members to require the matter be regulated by law instead.
35957.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the speed of an AMvB compared with formal legislation, while retaining a legislative review, Council of State advice and parliamentary pre-consultation.
q: An AMvB can usually be adopted faster than a formal law, but the proposed legal basis, as designed, retains the safeguards of a legislative review by the Ministry of Justice and Security, a review by the Council of State's advisory division, and a pre-consultation procedure in both chambers of the States General.

Een amvb kan doorgaans sneller tot stand komen dan een wet in formele zin, maar de voorgestelde juridische grondslag geeft, zoals deze is vormgegeven, wel de waarborgen van een wetgevingstoets van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, een toets door de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State en een voorhangprocedure bij beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal.
d: additional compensation for institutional bias or unfair debt-collection refusals in income-dependent schemes
compensation for children of beneficiaries entitled to qualifying recovery schemes
compensation for former partners of beneficiaries without own entitlement
p: Lets the executive define by AMvB new groups eligible for compensation, a field otherwise regulated by statute, subject to a four-week pre-consultation in both chambers that can force legislation instead.

parties: Asks how the bill relates to the restoration operation law and raises concern about the administrative capacity of the Tax and Customs Administration given growing caseloads.
These members ask the government to reflect on this extensively.
Deze leden vragen de regering hierop uitgebreid te reflecteren.
Questions why delegation is preferred over a substantive bill, and asks about the absence of safeguards when an AMvB is used instead of legislation, including the lack of legislative review.

These members ask the government to elaborate on the Council of State advisory division's point that when a decision is taken there are no safeguards, such as the legislative review by the Ministry of Justice and Security and an advisory opinion of the Division itself.

Deze leden vragen of de regering nader kan ingaan op het advies van de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State dat erop wijst dat bij een besluit geen waarborgen aanwezig zijn als de wetgevingstoets van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en een advies van de Afdeling zelf.
Asks why an AMvB rather than direct codification in formal law is chosen, other than for reasons of speed, and whether Council of State objections have been resolved.
Can the government explain why, other than for reasons of speed, an general administrative order should be chosen rather than direct codification at the level of a formal act?

Kan de regering aan de leden van de PVV-fractie aangeven waarom, anders dan om redenen van snelheid, gekozen zou moeten worden voor een algemene maatregel van bestuur en niet voor rechtstreekse codificatie op het niveau van een formele wet?
Questions whether delegation serves parliament's budget authority and careful deliberation, and notes that payments could be made before parliament can object, creating a democratic deficit.

Has the government considered that if the House cannot agree to an introduced general administrative order and payments have already been made because of the desired speed, either a democratic deficit or additional administrative complications arise?

Heeft de regering in haar overwegingen betrokken dat indien de Kamer niet akkoord kan gaan met een ingevoerde algemene maatregel van bestuur en er wegens de gewenste snelheid al wel is uitbetaald, er een ofwel een democratisch tekort ontstaat, ofwel additionele bestuurlijke complicaties ontstaan?
Worries that rigid, strictly drafted grounds will leave people with evident harm without rights, and asks whether all decisions on affected parties will be submitted to parliament.
The SP members ask the government whether all possible decisions taken concerning those affected will be submitted to parliament and discussed, so that parliament can also propose amendments.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen de regering voorts of alle mogelijke besluiten die omtrent gedupeerden worden genomen, aan het parlement worden voorgelegd en aldus worden besproken, waarin het parlement ook de mogelijkheid heeft om wijzigingen voor te stellen.
Asks why delegation is needed now given uncertainty about content, and requests an enhanced preliminary review (verzwaarde voorhang) and access to Council of State advice on AMvBs.

If the schemes are shaped in general administrative orders, the CDA members, given the great uncertainty about the elaboration and implementation, would like to add an enhanced preliminary review to this delegation provision, so that the House is not limited in its means of controlling legislation and regulation and their democratic legitimation.

Als de regelingen in Algemene Maatregelen van Bestuur worden vormgegeven, zien de leden van de CDA-fractie vanwege de grote onzekerheid rondom de uitwerking en de uitvoering ook bij deze delegatiebepaling graag de toevoeging van een verzwaarde voorhang, zodat de Kamer niet wordt beperkt in haar middelen tot controle van wet- en regelgeving en democratische legitimering hiervan.

Asks about the criteria for 'desired speed' justifying AMvB use, the scope of parliamentary involvement, whether heavy preliminary review will be used, and whether future schemes can be covered by the delegation.

These members ask the government what the criteria are for 'desired speed', when exactly it will be decided to regulate subjects through general administrative orders rather than bills, and what the House's involvement is in this possible decision.

Deze leden vragen de regering wat de criteria zijn voor «gewenste snelheid», wanneer precies besloten zal worden onderwerpen niet via wetsvoorstellen maar Algemene Maatregelen van Bestuur te regelen en wat de betrokkenheid van de Kamer is bij deze eventuele beslissing.
Argues that choosing speed over a separate legislative track per scheme undermines democratic legitimacy and parliament's role, and asks what additions were considered to protect parliament.
Why does the government not choose a separate legislative track for each scheme?
Waarom kiest de regering niet voor een afzonderlijk wetstraject per regeling?
Asks about the expected implementation costs and feasibility of realising the bill from 1 January and the timeline for delegation bases.
The BBB member asks the government to explain the expected implementation costs and aspects of the applicable policy decisions.
Het lid van de BBB fractie vraagt de regering toe te lichten wat de te verwachten uitvoeringskosten en -aspecten zijn van de geldende beleidsbesluiten.
Objects that the bill lets government set schemes without statute, arguing large spending should be regulated by law, and demands clarity on unlawful acts and the basis for compensation categories.
Member Omtzigt notes that the submitted bill gives the government the possibility to establish schemes without regulating them by law.
Het lid Omtzigt constateert dat het ingediende wetsvoorstel de regering de mogelijkheid geeft om regelingen vast te stellen zonder deze bij wet te regelen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a nota van wijziging adding delegation bases for supplementary recovery schemes in the childcare and other allowance restoration operation, raising concerns about legal basis, legislative quality and bundling in one bill. The government replied that it has split the delegation provisions into a separate Wet delegatiebepalingen hersteloperatie toeslagen and revised the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: Codifying partly on non-statutory goedkeurende beleidsbesluiten means essential elements remain outside the law or amvb; the government addressed this by clarifying the explanatory memorandum and legal bases.
Inserting the delegation bases into the bill on schrijnende gevallen risks insufficient parliamentary debate and conflicts with the motion Hoekstra; the government moved them into a separate bill.

The relationship with the broader herijking of the hersteloperatie and with existing instruments such as damages for unlawful acts was insufficiently explained; the government added clarifications but kept separate regimes.

35975-IIA.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2021 budget statement of the States General (parliament), raising appropriations for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint items by a total of about EUR 4.5 million in expenditure and EUR 1.4 million in receipts. It does not delegate rule-making or shift powers between institutions; it only adjusts budget figures and sets entry into force.
q: Amendment of the budget statement of the States General (IIA) for the year 2021
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2021

35984.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (Incidental Supplementary Budget for acquisition of an artwork), adjusting expenditure and revenue figures by article in thousands of euros. It sets the effective date as 8 December 2021, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35993.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment through an incidental supplementary budget, raising total spending commitments and expenditure by about €1.9 billion and €2.0 billion respectively. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 January 2022, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
35993.j: The memorandum justifies the budget change by estimating first-quarter 2022 costs of €16 million tied to COVID measures and Bbz use, noting that the estimate may be adjusted during 2022.
q: The budgetary consequences for the first quarter of 2022 are estimated at €16 million.
De budgettaire gevolgen voor het eerste kwartaal van 2022 worden geraamd op € 16 miljoen.

36350-IV.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statements (first supplementary budget) for the Ministry of Kingdom Relations (artikel IV) and the BES-fund, shifting funds such as Caribbean border control, detention facilities and the Dutch Caribbean rule-of-law budget. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, and the financial shifts are updates to budget allocations rather than new executive powers.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... Article 1 The budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2023 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd

36350-VI.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security (first supplementary budget), raising appropriations and revising revenue expectations for the ministry's policy articles and its agencies. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 June 2023.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36389.s: The bill lets municipalities grant a one-off 2023 energy allowance to low-income households at or just above the social minimum, under the Participatiewet. It also lets the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment grant a one-off energy cost allowance ex officio to independent students who receive both a basic and a supplementary grant, and adjusts the 2022 energy allowance law accordingly.
36389.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation and the categorical approach by the administrative burden on municipalities and the need to act quickly before the winter of 2023.
q: To limit municipal implementation burdens where possible, this bill proposes statutory exceptions for categories where energy costs cannot be assumed to the same degree.
Om de gemeentelijke uitvoeringslasten waar mogelijk te beperken, wordt met dit wetsvoorstel voorgesteld om wettelijke uitzonderingen te hanteren
d: amount of the one-off student energy allowance
further rules for implementing the student allowance
p: Excludes 18 to 20 year olds and certain other groups from the energy allowance, a categorical exclusion that narrows citizens' access to benefits without individual review.
Artikel I, onderdeel C (artikel 78ee, lid 3, 4 and 5)

Provides that the student allowance cannot be revised to the student's detriment, is not social assistance, and excludes the usual Participatiewet procedural articles, limiting review and appeal options for recipients.

parties: Asks whether municipal discretion over the 'low income' definition could lead to non-needy groups receiving the allowance and whether a minimum 120% threshold will be applied.
These members ask whether there is a chance that groups in society who do not need the energy allowance receive it, given that municipalities themselves determine what 'low income' means.

deze leden vragen de regering of de kans aanwezig is dat groepen in de samenleving wél de energietoeslag ontvangen die dit niet nodig hebben, gezien het feit dat gemeenten zelf bepalen wat onder «laag inkomen» verstaan moet worden
Welcomes the measure and thanks municipalities; asks for clarification of changes from 2022 and of the student amount and reach.
