First, these members are very grateful to municipalities for being willing to take on this task once again.</evidence_en>
Ten eerste zijn deze leden gemeenten zeer erkentelijk voor het feit dat zij nogmaals deze taak op zich willen nemen
Raises concerns about exclusion of students creating a 'vestzak-broekzak' effect with more reliance on individual assistance and asks about small-scale housing eligibility.
By categorically excluding students, the Council of State says a 'vestzak-broekzak' scenario may arise through increased reliance on individual assistance.</evidence_en>
lezen dat er door studenten categoriaal uit te sluiten, er volgens de Raad van State een vestzak-broekzakscenario kan ontstaan, door een toename van beroep op individuele bijstand
Criticizes arbitrary inequality between municipalities in eligibility and questions the amount, reach and exclusion of students, including court-ordered payments.
They are therefore negatively surprised that the government again chooses to maintain this arbitrariness.</evidence_en>
Zij zijn dan ook negatief verrast dat de regering er opnieuw voor kiest om deze willekeur in stand te houden.
Asks about legal durability of excluding non-nominal students and students without supplementary grants, and about municipal funding gaps and implementation timing.
To what extent does the government expect problems with the legal sustainability of excluding non-nominal students.</evidence_en>
In hoeverre verwacht de regering problemen met de juridische houdbaarheid van het uitzonderen van niet-nominale studenten
Asks how legal assurance and legal equality of implementation are secured given municipal policy freedom and the absence of binding limits.
To what extent is legal certainty and legal equality of the implementation of the energy allowance sufficiently guaranteed, they ask.</evidence_en>
In hoeverre is de rechtszekerheid en rechtsgelijkheid van de uitvoering van de energietoeslag voldoende geborgd, vragen zij.
Asks for justification of the €400 student amount set by ministerial regulation and the expected overcompensation and municipal costs.
The BBB member further wants the government to justify that the €400 mentioned in the explanatory letter is a reasonable contribution.</evidence_en>
Het lid van de BBB-fractie wenst verder onderbouwing van de regering dat de in de toelichtingsbrief genoemde € 400 een redelijke tegemoetkoming is

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in January 2023 that the explanatory memorandum for extending the 2023 categorical energy allowance under the Participatiewet (for low-income households, and excluding students) insufficiently justifies the blunt, categorical approach, its necessity given other 2023 purchasing-power measures, the exclusion of students, the cost estimates and the financing via the municipal fund. In the government's reply of June 2023, the minister largely maintains the necessity and categorical design, adds a DUO allowance for students with an outlying basic grant, adds justification on costs, and changes the deadline to 31 August 2024 and the funding allocation key.
concerns: The Afdeling found the necessity of extending the grofmazige energy allowance, given the 2023 purchasing-power package, insufficiently motivated; the government added explanation on inflation and energy cost burdens but kept the categorical approach, acknowledging it is coarse-grained.

The Afdeling questioned the blanket exclusion of all students, including full-time students with student finance living independently, as insufficiently justified against overcompensation arguments; the government added a DUO energy allowance for students with an outlying basic grant.
The Afdeling found the estimated high implementation costs of 100 million euro not substantiated; the government answered that implementation may vary per municipality and kept the budget.

The Afdeling asked for clarity on how funds from the municipal fund would be allocated adequately; the government switched to a decentralisation grant based on the CBS statistic on long-term low-income households, agreed with VNG.

36479.s: The bill requires schools' competent authorities to obtain, check annually and keep a copy of a certificate of good conduct (VOG) for staff of private supplemental education providers working in or under responsibility of the school during or right after teaching hours. It amends the education acts (WEC, WPO, WPO BES, WVO 2020) and related provisions on VOG storage and verification.
36479.j: The memorandum justifies the VOG requirement as necessary for a safe school environment and proportionate to the aim of protecting pupils, with reference to limits on privacy and free choice of occupation.
q: The bill provides for a statutory limitation on freedom of occupational choice for those who cannot obtain a VOG due to relevant antecedents.
Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in een bij wet gestelde beperking op de vrijheid van beroepskeuze voor hen die op grond van relevante antecedenten geen VOG kunnen verkrijgen.

parties: Asks whether commercial tutoring institutions that offer services directly to parents fall outside the VOG requirement and whether they should be covered.
They ask whether this means that, often commercial, tutoring institutes can remain out of view if they offer their services directly to parents.
Zij vragen of dit betekent dat, veelal commerciële, bijlesinstituten buiten beeld kunnen blijven als deze hun diensten rechtstreeks bij ouders aanbieden.

Asks about the scope of personnel covered, whether the VOG duty should apply to freelancers and contractors, and whether an annual check should also apply to school staff; asks about processing times and the Inspectorate's risk-based supervision and sanctions.
These members ask whether the government, by 'personnel', refers only to persons employed under an employment contract with a private education provider.
Daarnaast vragen zij of de regering met «personeel» enkel doelt op personen die in loondienst zijn bij een particuliere onderwijsaanbieder.
Supports making the certificate of conduct mandatory in supplementary education and has no further questions.
These members support the proposal and thank the government for it.
Deze leden steunen het voorstel en danken de regering ervoor.
The members of the BBB faction indicate that they forgo a contribution.
De leden van de BBB-fractie geven aan af te zien van de inbreng.

Worries about blurred responsibilities when a school rents space to an external organisation, asks about feasibility for schools under workload pressure, and prefers that a VOG remain valid while the person works at the school rather than repeated retention.
These members are concerned about the responsibilities the competent authority receives to check and retain a VOG when it merely makes a space available to a third party.

De leden van de CDA-fractie maken zich zorgen over de verantwoordelijkheden die het bevoegd gezag krijgt om een VOG te controleren en te bewaren indien het bevoegd gezag slechts een ruimte ter beschikking stelt aan een derde.

Questions the effectiveness and proportionality of the VOG, the four-year look-back period, the exclusion of natural persons acting on their own account, the annual check and six-month validity, whether parents as supervisors are covered, and whether the constitutional basis (art. 23 Grondwet) is correctly invoked.
These members ask why the government chooses to anchor in the law not only how old the VOG may be, but also that a check must take place every school year before the first activities.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen waarom de regering ervoor kiest om in de wet niet alleen te verankeren hoe oud de VOG mag zijn, maar ook dat ieder schooljaar voorafgaand aan de eerste werkzaamheden controle dient plaats te vinden.

Supports the aim of a safe school climate but questions the administrative burden of the annual check on the competent authority, the provider and Justis, and asks whether alternatives were considered.
These members believe this duty causes administrative burdens for the competent authority, the party offering the supplementary education, as well as Justis.
Deze leden menen dat deze plicht zorgt voor administratieve lasten voor zowel het bevoegd gezag, de partij die het aanvullend onderwijs aanbiedt, als Justis.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the Reparatiewet OCW technical repair bill should not include the mandatory VOG (certificate of good conduct) for supplementary education staff or the reinterpretation of the physical education hours norm, since these require substantive legislative choices unsuited to a repair law. The government reply accepted the advice by moving the VOG proposal into a separate bill and clarifying the physical education provisions, while retaining the hours change as a restoration of earlier law.
concerns: The VOG requirement for supplementary education staff interferes with privacy, equal treatment, freedom of education and occupational choice, and the explanatory memorandum did not justify necessity and proportionality, so the government expanded that justification but moved the provision to a separate bill.

Legislation on the VOG is not yet justified given the pending monitor on supplementary education and unclear scale of the sector; the government argued the monitor would not yield relevant information and did not await it.
The annual VOG checking obligation goes further than for school board staff and needs a reasoned proportionality assessment, which the government supplemented in the memorandum.
Technical and redactional corrections were made, and Wet taal en toegankelijkheid amendments were removed.

The urennorm for physical education is a reinterpretation of the Heerema/Van Nispen amendment that goes beyond a repair and lacks clarity and implementability; the government moved it out only in the sense of clarifying its restoration rationale and kept it in the bill.

36488.s: The bill adds article 14a to the Minimum Wage Act, raising the statutory minimum wage revision from 1 July 2024 by an additional 1.2 percentage points on top of the average contract wage development. The provision lapses on 1 July 2026.
36488.j: The memorandum justifies the one-off extra increase as keeping the minimum wage in step with collective-agreement wages, and explains that article 14a is to lapse because it is not suited to repeated application.
q: After this revision, article 14a can lapse, because it is not suited to repeated application.
Na deze herziening kan artikel 14a komen te vervallen, omdat het zich niet leent voor herhaalde toepassing.
d: Artikel I (wijziging Wet minimumloon, art. 8 eerste lid onder b)
setting the new minimum wage amounts after indexation

parties: Asks for a full overview of all benefits linked to the minimum wage and for detail on the arbeidskorting, welcoming the pass-through to benefits.
These members ask for a total overview of all benefits and schemes linked to the minimum wage.
Deze leden vragen om een totaaloverzicht van alle gekoppelde uitkeringen en regelingen aan het minimumloon.
Questions the cost to employers, SMEs and competitiveness, and criticises the manner in which the original amendment was financed.

Apart from the undesirable way in which the original amendment on which this bill is based was financed, these members still have some questions about the consequences of the proposed minimum wage increase.

Los van de onwenselijke wijze waarop het oorspronkelijke amendement waarop het nu voorliggende wetsvoorstel is gebaseerd werd gedekt hebben voorgenoemde leden nog welk enkele vragen ten aanzien van de consequenties van de voorgestelde verhoging van het minimumloon.
Asks how the bill relates to the Commissie sociaal minimum advice, the benefits system and the EU minimum wage directive.
The NSC members ask the government to indicate how this bill relates to the EU Directive on the level of the social minimum.
De leden van de NSC-fractie vragen de regering aan te geven hoe dit wetsvoorstel zich verhoudt tot de Europese Unie (EU-)Richtlijn voor de hoogte van het sociaal minimum.
Welcomes the bill as implementing the amendment and asks about the timing of income-threshold indexation and effects for 2025.
These members thank the government for the proposal that gives effect to the adopted Van der Lee et al. amendment, which supports household purchasing power in 2024 and structurally.
Deze leden danken de regering voor het voorstel dat invulling geeft aan het aangenomen amendement Van der Lee c.s. dat de koopkracht van huishoudens in 2024 en structureel ondersteunt.
Questions the choice of instrument, the Raad van State's critical remarks on the AOW coupling, the rising marginal tax burden and the absence of an SME test.
These members ask the government to elaborate on the critical remarks of the Raad van State on this point.
Deze leden vragen nader in te gaan op de kritische opmerkingen van de Raad van State op dit punt.
Raises the cost-effectiveness of the AOW coupling given low poverty risk among pensioners, referring to Raad van State comments, and the intergenerational transfer via the pension franchise.

On the one hand this coupling improves the purchasing power of older people; on the other hand it is an extremely costly measure whose efficiency, given the low poverty risk among pensioners, is doubtful.

Enerzijds bevordert deze koppeling de koopkrachtpositie van ouderen, anderzijds is het een uitermate kostbare maatregel waarvan de doelmatigheid (gezien het lage risico op armoede onder gepensioneerden) twijfelachtig is.
Asks about effects on middle incomes, marginal tax pressure across income classes, smaller versus larger firms, and price pressure in sectors with many minimum-wage workers.
The BBB members ask the government what the effects are for middle incomes, whether middle-income wages are not squeezed as a result, and what effect this has on wage pressure generally.

De leden van de BBB-fractie vragen de regering wat de effecten zijn voor de middeninkomens, of de lonen van middeninkomens hierdoor niet in verdrukking komen en welk effect dit heeft op de druk op de lonen in het algemeen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill raising the statutory minimum wage by 1.2% from 1 July 2024, questioning the efficiency and intergenerational solidarity of the full pass-through to the AOW state pension given its large budgetary cost and low poverty risk among pensioners. The minister's reply expanded the explanatory memorandum to motivate the pass-through to the AOW and sent the bill to parliament without changing the proposal.
concerns: The Afdeling questions whether full pass-through of the minimum wage increase to the AOW is efficient, given the large cost and that pensioners face low poverty risk, and asks for better motivation.
The Afdeling asks the explanatory memorandum to address intergenerational solidarity and the trade-off with budget room for more targeted support against poverty.

36578.s: The bill moves several statutory transition deadlines for the Dutch pension reform (Wet toekomst pensioenen) out of the Pensioenwet, Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling, Wet LB 1964 and the bedrijfstakpensioenfonds act, and into algemene maatregelen van bestuur, and extends the transition period by one year. It also clarifies that funds intending a bridging plan must notify the supervisor by 1 April.
36578.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by the need to adapt deadlines flexibly to monitored developments and to avoid undesirable effects from 170 pension funds, while keeping parliament involved through voorhang.
q: By placing this in an AMvB, it is possible to respond better to current developments and to intervene timely and adequately.
Door dit in een AMvB onder te brengen kan beter worden ingespeeld op actuele ontwikkelingen en kan tijdig en adequaat worden ingegrepen
d: end date of transition period for pension funds
date for end of compensation period
implementation plan deadline and bridging plan timing
deadlines for bridging and recovery plans
deadline for insurers and premium pension institutions
date for emergence of a condition
transition deadline for industry pension funds
transition deadlines for occupational pension funds
p: Statutory transition dates are moved into executive orders that can be changed without a new law, subject to a four-week pre-publication to parliament and Raad van State advice.

parties: Asks whether parliament will be involved in decisions to extend the transition period, and whether such decisions will always be submitted to parliament via a general administrative order.
Does the government intend to always submit a general administrative order on this subject to parliament, or only when members of the chambers ask for it?
Is de regering van plan een algemene maatregel van bestuur met betrekking tot dit onderwerp altijd aan het parlement voor te leggen, of alleen als leden van de Kamers daar om vragen?
Asks for the basis of stated labour market and budget effects and for an explanation of financial amounts under the Recovery and Resilience Facility.
On what data is this statement based?
Op welke gegevens is deze uitspraak gebaseerd?
Questions why the extension is moved to a general administrative order rather than the normal legislative process, as the Council of State advised, and why the end date was not set in legislation.
These members do not see why there is no time to extend the transition period through a normal legislative process.
Deze leden zien niet in waarom er geen tijd is om het verlengen van de transitieperiode via een normaal wetgevingsproces te doen.

Warns that the legislature may end up having to follow the pace set by implementing organisations since the transition period can be easily adjusted, and asks how the decision to extend will be made and on what objective grounds.
Now that the transition period can be adjusted fairly easily, there is a risk that the legislature has to follow the speed of implementation.
Nu de transitieperiode vrij eenvoudig aangepast kan worden, is er een risico dat de wetgever de snelheid van de uitvoering moet volgen.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division accepts extending the pension transition period by one year to 1 January 2028 but advises against moving transition deadlines to lower regulation and asks for the transition-ftk's fairness to be addressed in the explanatory memorandum. The government's reply largely agrees, adds a pre-consultation (voorhang) procedure for the amvb, and keeps the transfer of dates to an amvb while explaining the safeguards.
concerns: Advice to set the extended 1 January 2028 deadline in the statute rather than in an amvb to preserve certainty and firm deadlines; the government keeps the amvb route but adds a voorhang procedure.

Transfer of transition dates to lower regulation reduces the formal legislature's influence over the end date; the government acknowledges this and points to the voorhang procedure and a regeringscommissaris as safeguards.

The explanatory memorandum should address the effects of a longer transition period on the balance of the transition-ftk; the government's reply explains the existing safeguards, which it considers sufficient.

36600-IX.s: This bill fixes the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (article IXB) and the budget of the National Debt (article IXA) in thousands of euros, with entry into force on 1 January of the budget year. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no oversight changes; the explanatory memorandum describes budget items for tax administration, financial markets, the Btw-compensatiefonds, and debt financing.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) attached to this act for the year 2025 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het ministerie van Financiën (IXB) voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the draft 2025 budget statements for the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and National Debt (IXA) and advised submission to the House. The Minister's reply notes the blank advice and reports technical updates to the budget figures based on final CPB projections and August decision-making.

36668.s: The bill creates a legal basis allowing customs inspectors to disclose data, including data covered by professional secrecy, to the police, the Royal Marechaussee, the financial intelligence unit and the FIOD for policing and supervisory tasks. Disclosure is limited to offences carrying at least four years' imprisonment (or serious financial/fiscal crime), with anonymisation where effectiveness allows, a five-year evaluation report, and implementing rules set by general administrative order.
36668.j: The memorandum justifies the new disclosure powers by the need to combat serious and undermining crime and money laundering, and notes that existing police and FIU powers to request data are regulated elsewhere.
q: It was chosen to set the limit at offences carrying a statutory prison sentence of four years or more, because these situations are serious enough to justify an exception to professional secrecy.

Er is voor gekozen om de grens te leggen bij misdrijven waarop naar de wettelijke omschrijving een gevangenisstraf van vier jaar of meer is gesteld, omdat deze situaties voldoende ernstig zijn om een uitzondering op het beroepsgeheim te rechtvaardigen
d: kinds of data, security, support, balancing of interests and request requirements for police disclosure
kinds of data and request requirements for FIU/FIOD disclosure
p: Allows the inspector, at discretion, to disclose confidential customs data on individual cases to police and Marechaussee on his own initiative, overriding professional secrecy, subject to a case-by-case interest balancing.
Artikel I (art. 1:40, lid 1 and 2 Algemene douanewet)
Permits disclosure of confidential customs data to the FIU and FIOD, including bulk data for systemic analysis, lifting professional secrecy for financial and fiscal investigations.

parties: Asks about criteria for sharing data before any crime has occurred, how affected persons can exercise rights and inspect shared data, and asks for an evaluation provision.
Can the government clarify how persons whose data are shared can exercise their rights in the situation this bill aims to regulate.
Kan de regering verduidelijken hoe betrokkenen waarover gegevens worden verstrekt, hun rechten kunnen herroepen in de situatie die het voorliggende wetsvoorstel beoogt te regelen.
Questions why data is not anonymised by default in the statutory text, who checks purpose limitation (risk of the requesting party checking itself) and what consequences follow unlawful disclosure.
Does this task lie with the requesting party, so that there could be a butcher checking his own meat?
Ligt deze taak bij de verzoekende partij, waardoor er sprake kan zijn van een slager die het eigen vlees keurt?

Supports effective tackling of crime but asks how the inspector's public-interest balancing is supported and checked, how the right to privacy is safeguarded against arbitrariness, and who oversees lawful exchange between Customs and FIOD.
Who checks the lawful data exchange between Customs and the FIOD, both units of the Ministry of Finance?
Wie controleert op de rechtmatige gegevensuitwisseling tussen de douane en de FIOD, beiden een dienstonderdeel van het Ministerie van Financiën?

Questions the added value of the bill given existing sharing options, notification of affected persons, deletion after unfounded suspicion, compatibility with the Charter, ECHR and Dutch constitution, and oversight by the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens.
Is the person or company whose data are shared with investigative services informed of this?
Wordt de persoon of het bedrijf waarvan gegevens worden gedeeld met opsporingsdiensten hiervan op de hoogte gesteld?
Stresses proportionality and citizens' rights, asks who audits data handling, whether an external party supervises it, and whether citizens learn their data is used.
Is this guaranteed by an external party outside the police, Kmar and the Ministry of Finance?
Wordt dit gewaarborgd door een externe partij buiten de politie, Kmar en Ministerie van Financiën?
Has no additional questions at this stage.
These members currently have no additional questions.
Deze leden hebben op dit moment geen aanvullende vragen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in August 2024 that the draft Wet gegevensverstrekking douane, which would allow customs to share data with police, KMar, FIU and FIOD before a criminal suspicion exists, needs better justification of necessity and proportionality, clearer conditions, safeguards and an evaluation clause. The government's December 2024 reply accepted most points, amended the bill and explanatory memorandum, but rejected the evaluation clause on effectiveness grounds while adding a narrower evaluation of safeguards.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for fuller motivation of necessity and proportionality of the data sharing, including existing sharing possibilities and the risks of bulk data, and the government added this to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked for clearer safeguards against improper requests and for explaining how data subjects can exercise their rights, with the government adding references to article 14(5) GDPR and anonymisation but leaving the practical route for data subjects less concretised.

The Afdeling asked for clearer conditions on when individual-case data may be shared, including the vague 'zwaarwegend algemeen belang' criterion and the lower threshold for FIOD, and the government clarified the scope and examples.

The Afdeling asked for the offence threshold of four years' imprisonment to be linked to undermining crime, and the government clarified that the purpose extends to other serious crime with the threshold assessed via the request's justification.
The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify who is responsible for checking whether conditions for data sharing are met, and the government specified the primary responsibility.

The Afdeling noted the difference between the Unierechtelijke beroepsgeheim and the AWR confidentiality duty and asked for clarification; the government replaced 'geheimhoudingsplicht' with 'beroepsgeheim' and clarified scope.

The Afdeling advised an evaluation clause after a few years on efficiency and safeguards, but the government included an evaluation of safeguards only, arguing an evaluation of effectiveness against crime figures is not feasible.

36677.s: The bill amends the Dutch Embryo Act to redefine an embryo to include embryo-like entities made from pluripotent stem cells and other methods, extends regulation to such entities, and allows the Minister to impose administrative fines for lighter violations. It also makes several technical and gender-neutral wording changes and adds a supervisory-related fine power to be delegated to the Inspectorate.
36677.j: The memorandum justifies the administrative fine power by arguing that not all proscribed conduct is equally serious, so criminal sanctions are not always appropriate.
q: One of the reasons for the proposal to introduce an administrative fine is that on closer examination not every proscribed conduct can be regarded as equally serious, so a criminal sanction is not always appropriate.

Een van de redenen voor het voorstel om een bestuurlijke boete te introduceren, is dat bij nadere bestudering van de strafbaar gestelde gedragingen niet elke gedraging als even ernstig kan worden aangemerkt, zodat niet altijd een strafrechtelijke sanctie gepast is.
d: central committee may designate non-invasive research on foetuses reviewed by a recognised committee
Minister's power to impose administrative fines up to fourth category
p: Introduces a ministerial power to impose administrative fines up to the fourth criminal fine category as an alternative to criminal prosecution, with objection and appeal open against such decisions.

parties: Asks how the new embryo definition avoids legal grey areas and who decides which embryo-like structures fall under the law.
How is it determined which ELS fall under the law and which do not, and who is responsible for this assessment?
Hoe wordt bepaald welke ELS onder de wet vallen en welke niet, en wie is verantwoordelijk voor deze toetsing?
Asks the government to explain the balancing of interests regarding embryo-like structures and the role of the CCMO and METCs.
Could the government further explain what balancing of interests it made regarding ELS and what conclusion it reached?
Zou de regering alsnog nader kunnen toelichten welke belangenafweging zij heeft gemaakt met betrekking tot de ELS en tot welke conclusie zij is gekomen?
Says the law is incomplete, questions whether the CCMO should assess experiment size, and asks how the evaluation's advice on chimaeras was followed.
The members are critical of the law because in their view it is not complete and the new embryo definition does not achieve the law's aim of regulating acts with new embryo-like structures.

De leden zijn kritisch op de wet omdat deze naar hun mening niet volledig is en omdat met de nieuwe definitie van een embryo het doel van de wet om handelingen met nieuwe embryo-achtige structuren te reguleren niet wordt behaald.
Asks why CCMO rather than METC reviews prenatal non-lifesaving treatment and why the evaluation's 'no days' wording was not followed.
Can the government further explain which types of research this makes possible?
Kan de regering verder toelichten welke typen onderzoeken hiermee mogelijk worden gemaakt?
Asks about the definition's gendered wording and the use of gender-neutral terms in the law.
The members urgently wonder why the State Secretary constantly tries to introduce gender-neutral personal designations into laws, even when there is no need.
De leden vragen zich met klem af waarom de Staatssecretaris constant sekseneutrale persoonsaanduidingen probeert door te voeren in wetten, zelfs als deze noodzaak er niet is.
Asks who decides whether there is a reasonable expectation of development and what happens if a structure later proves to qualify.
Who determines whether there is a 'reasonable expectation'?
Wie bepaalt of er sprake is van een «redelijkerwijze verwachting»?
Asks which organs could be studied and about the government's position on the Health Council advice to extend the 14-day limit.
What is the current government's view on the Health Council advice to adjust the fourteen-day limit, and does it still plan to act on this advice?
Wat is de visie van de huidige regering op het advies van de Gezondheidsraad om de veertiendagengrens aan te passen en heeft zij nog plannen om gevolg te geven aan dit advies?
Argues the new definition devalues real embryos and that the government relies on public opinion rather than explicit balancing; asks for a clear normative limit.
The SGP members believe that adding simulated embryos (ELS) to the definition of 'embryo' detracts from the dignity of actual human embryos.

De leden van de SGP-fractie menen zij dat het toevoegen van nagebootste embryo’s (ELS) aan het definitie van het begrip «embryo» afbreuk doet aan de waardigheid van daadwerkelijke menselijke embryo’s.
Asks for ethical study of intact ELS, whether METCs have enough expertise, and why no notification duty to the CCMO was introduced.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a draft amendment to the Embryo Act that redefines 'embryo' by origin and allows embryo-like structures to be created for research, asking for a fuller balancing of interests and clarification of 'biological science'. The Secretary of State's reply accepts these points by expanding the explanatory memorandum and dropping the added 'biological science' purpose.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum lacks a visible weighing of the protection of embryos, including embryo-like structures, against scientific progress, and the government added reasoning on why ELS are considered less sensitive.
The memorandum does not explain what 'biological science' means as a research purpose for ELS, and the government removed that added purpose from the bill and adjusted the explanation.

36686.s: The bill tightens integrity rules for healthcare and youth-care providers: it sets normal-market-terms requirements for significant transactions with related parties, bans undue financial risk, restricts profit distributions with financial ratio conditions, and gives the NZa supervisory powers. It also abolishes the CSZ property-approval regime, expands grounds to refuse or revoke operating licences including over disfunctioning managers, and repeals the Wet toelating zorginstellingen.
36686.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations to set exceptions and calculation rules by saying general measures allow adaptation to new developments affecting care quality, accessibility and affordability.
q: Forms of care not subject to the profit distribution ban are designated by general administrative order (amvb), as is already the case.
Vormen van zorg die niet onder het winstuitkeringsverbod vallen, worden bij algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) aangewezen, zoals dat nu ook het geval is.
d: Artikel I, D (Art. 40e lid 1; Art. 40f lid 2-3; Art. 40g lid 2)
exceptions to profit ban and ratio calculation rules
conditions for transactions with social-purpose parties
Artikel II, B (Art. 4.5.3 lid 3; Art. 4.5.4 lid 2)
categories of youth-care providers exempted from rules
p: The Minister gains broader discretion to refuse or revoke licences based on disfunctioning managers, supervisors or persons with control, and on risks to good governance.
Artikel I, G (Art. 76 lid 3) and Artikel II, I (Art. 78h lid 2)
The NZa may order recovery of unlawfully paid profit distributions from recipients through directions to providers.
Supervisory bodies must share personal data and registration numbers with the Minister for licensing decisions.
Artikel IV-XI (repeal of Wet toelating zorginstellingen, Wlz art. 9.1.5, Zvw art. 91 and related)
The bill repeals the Wet toelating zorginstellingen and the CSZ prior-approval role over property transactions, removing a prior oversight check.

parties: Asks whether the bill will sufficiently help tackle care fraud and why profit distributions are not set to zero.
They ask whether this bill will actually contribute sufficiently to tackling care fraud.
Zo vragen zij of dit wetsvoorstel daadwerkelijk voldoende gaat bijdragen aan het aanpakken van zorgfraude.
Sees the bill as a step forward but too limited; questions why youth care providers are excluded from profit-distribution bans and asks how municipalities supervise declarations.
These members see this bill as a step in the right direction, but find it too limited as well.
Genoemde leden zien dit wetsvoorstel als een stapje in de goede richting, maar vinden het ook te beperkt.
Welcomes the fight against fraud with care funds but asks how much the bill increases detection and whether the Governance Code is a workable norm.
The VVD members welcome the government's initiative to tackle fraud with care funds.
De leden van de VVD-fractie verwelkomen de aanzet van de regering om fraude met zorggeld aan te pakken.
Asks how market conformity is assessed, who decides, whether legitimate cooperation is hindered, and whether proportionality is guaranteed.
Can the government indicate whether there is a risk of hindering legitimate cooperation between, for example, GP cooperatives or care institutions and societal partners?
Kan de regering aangeven of er een risico is op belemmering van legitieme samenwerking tussen bijvoorbeeld huisartsencoöperaties of zorginstellingen met maatschappelijke partners?
Has no additional questions beyond those of the rapporteurs.
These members join the input of the rapporteurs of the VWS committee and have no additional questions.
Deze leden sluiten zich aan bij de inbreng van de rapporteurs van de commissie VWS en hebben geen aanvullende vragen.
Has questions for the government; substance not stated in the excerpt.
These members have the following questions for the government.
Deze leden hebben de volgende vragen aan de regering.
Warns that the two aims (excluding non-integer providers and tightening profit-distribution bans) are being mixed and asks whether they should be split into separate bills.
These members ask whether the government agrees that these are two distinct aims and therefore two distinct debates.
Deze leden vragen of de regering deelt dat dit twee onderscheiden doelen en daarmee ook twee onderscheiden discussies zijn
Misses a full ban on private equity in care and questions why the government reversed its earlier position on profit distribution.
The SP members miss a total ban on private equity in care in this bill, although the House has repeatedly asked for one.
De leden van de SP-fractie missen in dit wetsvoorstel een totaalverbod op private equity in de zorg, terwijl de Kamer hier meermaals om heeft gevraagd.
Asks for a sound problem analysis and whether existing instruments are insufficient or underused; worries about compliance burden for small providers.
The money spent on this does not go to care.
Het geld dat hieraan wordt besteed, gaat niet naar de zorg.
Doubts effectiveness and scope; notes the bill contains no ban on private equity ownership despite requests from the House, and asks why open norms are used instead of a mandatory Governance Code.
Moreover, the ChristenUnie members note that the bill contains no ban on ownership by venture capitalists (private equity).
Daarenboven constateren de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie dat in het wetsvoorstel geen verbod op eigenaarschap door durfkapitalisten (private equity) is opgenomen

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised in June 2024 that the draft Wet integere bedrijfsvoering zorg- en jeugdhulpaanbieders needed reconsideration: the problem analysis was lacking, existing rules and governance codes were not shown to be insufficient, a general scheme for very diverse providers was questioned, winstuitkering conditions should be set in law rather than by AMvB, and the power to refuse or revoke licences over disfunctionerende bestuurders was disproportionate. The minister's nader rapport of January 2025 reports that the bill was largely amended: open integrity norm replaced by two specific norms, winstuitkering conditions moved into the law, the licence power narrowed, and the explanatory memorandum expanded, while the minister maintains that the Governancecode cannot serve as a publicly enforceable basis.
concerns: The Afdeling found the problem analysis insufficient and the need for the new rules unsubstantiated given existing publiekrechtelijke rules and governance codes; the government expanded the memorandum with examples and explained the gaps but did not accept that existing rules suffice.

The open integrity norm was judged disproportionate and overlapping with the Governancecode; the government replaced it with two more specific norms on normal market terms and avoidance of unjustified risks.

The power to refuse or revoke licences because of past conduct of board members or supervisors was considered a disproportionate instrument that should be replaced by a targeted scheme; the government narrowed and explained the power but kept it.
Conditions on profit distributions were to be set by AMvB, creating uncertainty for investors; the government moved the core conditions into the statute itself.
A general scheme covering very diverse care providers was questioned; the government argued the specific norms are flexible and that supervision can be differentiated.

The Afdeling suggested designating the Governancecode zorg as publicly enforceable instead of separate statutory norms; the government declined, citing its principle-based character and lack of government influence over it.

36776.s: The bill amends several Dutch laws on energy, climate, mining and environment: it makes the Scientific Climate Council (WKR) a statutory body, renames the Klimaatfonds to Klimaat- en energiefonds, and introduces a statutory duty to tolerate survey activities during the design phase of certain public-interest projects. It also restores the uniform open preparation procedure and sole appeal to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak for geothermal permits, extends the NEa's power to request data, and makes various technical corrections.
36776.j: The memorandum justifies the design-phase survey duty by pointing to delays and inflexibility of the existing gedoogplichtbeschikking procedure, and the delegations as enabling technical detail for implementation.
q: In the design phase it mostly concerns short-term factual research that has no permanent consequences for the land of the rightholders.
In de ontwerpfase gaat het veelal om kortdurend, feitelijk onderzoek dat geen permanente gevolgen heeft voor de gronden van de rechthebbenden.
d: Artikel II, onderdeel D (Energiewet art. 2.25, vierde lid)
rules on customer data transfer and supply contracts of licence holders
Artikel II, onderdeel G (Energiewet art. 2.46, tweede lid, onderdeel d)
which party determines energy volumes at unmetered connections
Artikel IV, onderdeel D (Mijnbouwwet art. 24ab, negende lid)
further rules on grounds for amending geothermal start permits
Artikel IX, onderdeel A (Wet milieubeheer art. 16.1a)
data to be provided to the NEa on request by grid operators and tax authority
Artikel IX, onderdeel F (Wet milieubeheer art. 16.39ag)
rules on identifying fuel volumes, EU ETS implementing act and double counting
p: Introduces a statutory duty to tolerate survey work for design of public-interest projects without a prior administrative decision, removing administrative appeal and leaving only civil court review.
Artikel IV, onderdeel B (Mijnbouwwet art. 24v) and onderdeel B of Artikel I (Algemene wet bestuursrecht Bijlage 2)
Restores direct appeal only to the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak for geothermal permits prepared under the uniform open preparation procedure, shortening the appeal route for citizens and parties.
Artikel IX, onderdeel A (Wet milieubeheer art. 16.1a)
Gives the NEa power to request data from tax authority, grid operators and others as needed for enforcement.

parties: Asks about the timing of the KEV and Klimaatnota, whether a separate parliamentary moment will remain, and about a fundamental revision of the Mijnbouwwet and subsidence protection.
These members consider it important that a separate moment remains for reflecting on the state of climate policy.
Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat er een apart moment blijft bestaan waarop wordt stilgestaan bij de staat van het klimaatbeleid.

Supports the bill's aims but asks for guarantees against a waterbed effect shifting burdens to civil procedures and asks the government to reflect on the Raad voor de rechtspraak's criticism of weakened legal protection for interested parties.
In addition, they ask the government to reflect on the Raad voor de rechtspraak's criticism regarding the scaling back of legal protection for interested parties.
Daarnaast vragen zij de regering te reflecteren op de kritiek van de Raad voor de rechtspraak met betrekking tot de versobering van de rechtsbescherming van belanghebbenden.
Questions whether a multi-subject amendment law meets the Raad van State's cumulative conditions, especially coherence, arguing shared ministerial responsibility is too thin a justification.

These members find the government's answer that the various parts are thematically connected, because they all fall within climate and green growth policy and under the Minister's responsibility, rather thin.

Deze leden vinden het antwoord van de regering dat de verschillende onderdelen thematisch met elkaar samenhangen, omdat ze allen op het beleidsterrein van Klimaat en Groene Groei liggen en onder de bevoegdheid van de Minister van Klimaat en Groene Groei vallen nogal mager.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that a multi-subject omnibus bill (amending the Omgevingswet, Klimaatwet, Energiewet and others) insufficiently justifies its omnibus character and that the reintroduction of the statutory access obligation (gedoogplicht van rechtswege) for design phases lacks explanation of why the 2024 beschikking requirement was chosen. The Minister's nader rapport adds justification for the omnibus choice and shifts the notification duty from the mayor to the project initiator, plus adds the net op zee and technical corrections.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to justify why all measures are bundled in one omnibus bill; the government added thematic-coherence and proportionality arguments.

The Afdeling asked for clarification of why the 2024 beschikking requirement for the gedoogplicht was introduced and whether reverting to a statutory obligation is justified given legal protection; the government clarified the mayor's role was unclear and replaced it with an initiator duty.

36785.s: The bill reforms enforcement across Dutch social security laws (AKW, Anw, AOW, Participatiewet, Remigratiewet, Toeslagenwet and others) by replacing mandatory full recovery and fixed sanctions with discretionary powers to warn, impose administrative fines, reduce recovery, and grant exemptions for hardship or administrative error. It codifies a broader 'urgent reasons' test and six-month limits on recovery for known information, and delegates detailed rules, including sanction amounts and categories, to algemene maatregel van bestuur and ministerial regulation.
36785.j: The memorandum justifies the discretionary powers and delegations as necessary for more proportionate enforcement, legal certainty and workable administration, following case law and advice from the NSOB and others.
q: The bill explicitly does not create a possibility for the Minister to waive recovery in individual cases; that power remains with the implementing body.
Met het wetsvoorstel wordt uitdrukkelijk geen mogelijkheid voor de Minister gecreëerd om in individuele gevallen af te zien van terugvordering.
d: Artikel I A (art. 14a AKW, new lid 5)
conditions for SVB to refrain from revision or withdrawal of benefits
further rules on sanctions and when warnings or measures may be waived
conditions for SVB to waive recovery in case of large numbers of cases
further rules on sanctions and waivers for municipalities
manner of enforcing administrative fine decisions
conditions for municipality to waive recovery in large case volumes
obligation of conduct toward officials of the implementing bodies
p: Artikel I B, Artikel 17 AKW and parallel provisions
Replaces mandatory sanctions with discretionary power to impose measures or warnings, giving the agency wide latitude over benefit suspension, with proportionality as the main limit.
Artikel IV F and Artikel I F art. 24 AKW (recovery exemptions)
Adds codified exemptions from recovery for administrative error and information known over six months, which narrows executive recovery powers in favour of citizens.
Artikel VI B and Artikel V C (Toeslagenwet and Remigratiewet sanctions)
Extends warning and administrative fine powers and delegates sanction amounts and categories to lower-level rules, with limited parliamentary involvement.
Artikel IV I (art. 54 Participatiewet) and Artikel I A (Anw revision)
Allows the agency to refrain from revision or withdrawal of benefits in categories by general measure, limited by a five-year lookback.

parties: Asks why the 'tenzij' formulation was chosen for waiving recovery after agency error and whether it will create uncertainty for beneficiaries.
These members ask the government to explain further why it chose the 'unless' formulation.
Deze leden vragen de regering om nader toe te lichten waarom zij voor de «tenzij» formulering heeft gekozen.
Asks how open norms such as 'passend informeren' and 'vergissing' will be applied uniformly across agencies to avoid arbitrariness, and how capacity is ensured.
How will the government ensure that these open norms are applied unambiguously and uniformly by all implementing bodies (UWV, SVB and municipalities)?
Hoe gaat de regering waarborgen dat deze open normen door alle uitvoeringsorganisaties (UWV, SVB en gemeenten) eenduidig en uniform worden toegepast
Asks how disputed facts (beneficiary versus government say-so) are handled within the discretion framework and why the recovery and waiver periods are set as they are.
What if the person says they are receiving too much benefit but the government says it is correct?
Wat als de betrokkenen aangeeft teveel uitkering te ontvangen maar de overheid aangeeft dat het wel klopt
Asks how the undefined term 'vergissen' will be clarified and whether the bill risks insufficient clarity, while stressing the need for a balanced fraud approach.
These members understand that further definition could be limiting, but also draw attention to the possibility that the absence of a definition offers insufficient clarity.
Deze leden begrijpen dat nadere definiëring beperkend kan werken, maar vragen ook aandacht voor de mogelijkheid dat het ontbreken van een definitie onvoldoende duidelijkheid biedt.
Asks whether implementing agencies must ex officio test proportionality before recovery and whether the codified case law is taken over verbatim.
The ChristenUnie members ask the government whether, under this bill, implementing bodies must ex officio test the proportionality principle when recovery is involved.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen de regering of conform voorliggend wetsvoorstel uitvoeringsinstanties ambtshalve het evenredigheidsbeginsel moeten toetsen wanneer sprake is van een terugvordering.
Asks about safeguards against unequal treatment through postcode- or area-based selection and whether municipalities' fine revenues create a financial incentive to sanction.
Does the government share the concern that when municipalities choose between imposing a fine or another measure, the financial incentive to fine may lead to a preference for fines?

Deelt de regering de zorg van de leden van de GroenLinks-PvdA-fractie dat, wanneer gemeenten voor de keuze staan tussen het opleggen van een boete of het nemen van een andere maatregel, de financiële prikkel om te beboeten kan leiden tot de voorkeur voor het opleggen van boetes
Asks how much additional implementation capacity and budget the bill requires and what effect ICT capacity use has on other UWV projects.
The SGP members would like to be informed how much additional implementation capacity is needed as a result of this bill.
De leden van de SGP-fractie worden graag geïnformeerd over hoeveel (aanvullende) uitvoeringscapaciteit nodig is als gevolg van dit wetsvoorstel.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division on a bill creating a new enforcement framework for all social security laws advised that the formal warning should not be treated as a reviewable decision because it has no legal effect, and that categorical waiver of recovery be regulated by general administrative order and limited to cases of government error affecting a large group. The minister's reply accepts both points and amends the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The formal warning as proposed has no legal consequence and should not be classed as an administrative decision open to appeal under Awb article 1:3.
Categorical waiver of recovery of undue payments should be regulated by general administrative order rather than ministerial regulation.
The delegation provision should be aligned with the explanatory memorandum so that categorical waiver is limited to extraordinary circumstances of government error affecting a larger group.
Sufficient implementation capacity is needed for proportionate enforcement and this should receive more attention in the explanatory memorandum.

36800-IV.s: This bill sets the 2026 budget statements for Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) and the BES-fonds (H), fixing the amounts in thousands of euros and taking effect on 1 January 2026. The explanatory memorandum describes priorities on governance, institutional strengthening, integrity and rule of law in the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom, with funding for border supervision, judicial capacity and loans to Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
q: The budget statement for Kingdom Relations (IV) belonging to this act for the year 2026 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2026 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) and made no remarks, recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets need amendments, which are set out in annexes.

36800-VI.s: This bill (Wetsvoorstel) sets the 2026 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Ministry of Justice and Security, along with the budgets of six agencies, and specifies that the minister is not responsible for the efficiency of judicial business operations. The explanatory memorandum describes the budget allocations and policy priorities but does not delegate rule-making or new executive powers.
q: Referring to article 4.1 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2016 in conjunction with articles 23 and 91 of the Judiciary Organisation Act, the Minister is not responsible for the efficiency of the judiciary's business operations.

Onder verwijzing naar artikel 4.1 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2016 jo. de artikelen 23 en 91 van de Wet op de rechterlijke organisatie is Onze Minister niet verantwoordelijk voor de doelmatigheid van de bedrijfsvoering van de rechterlijke organisatie.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State states it has no remarks on the draft Wet tot vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid for 2026 and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The minister's nader rapport explains that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes to the reply.

36857.s: The bill approves for the European part of the Netherlands the Partnership Agreement concluded at Apia, Samoa on 15 November 2023 between the European Union and its member states and the members of the Organisation of African, Caribbean and Pacific States. The law enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
36857.j: The memorandum explains that the agreement falls under EU competences and that the Netherlands has no binding direct-effect obligations, and it describes the treaty's internal bodies and procedures for amending regional protocols.
q: In the government's view the treaty contains no provisions binding on everyone within the meaning of articles 93 and 94 of the Constitution.
Naar het oordeel van de regering bevat het verdrag geen een ieder verbindende bepalingen in de zin van de artikelen 93 en 94 van de Grondwet
d: approval of partnership agreement and its regional protocols by Council of Ministers

parties: Asks how the dispute settlement mechanism's appropriate and proportionate measures are defined, following the Council of State's remark that this was unclear.
The VVD members note that the Council of State writes it is unclear what appropriate and proportionate measures within the dispute settlement arrangement may consist of.
De leden van de VVD-fractie lezen dat de Raad van State schrijft dat het niet duidelijk is waaruit passende en proportionele maatregelen kunnen bestaan binnen de geschillenregeling.
Asks what sanctions and monitoring mechanisms exist if partner countries structurally fail to honour migration and other commitments, and how Netherlands can intervene.
The CDA members ask which monitoring mechanisms are available and how the Netherlands will act within the EU if partner countries structurally fail to meet agreements.
De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen verder welke monitoringmechanismen beschikbaar zijn en hoe Nederland in EU-verband gaat optreden als partnerlanden afspraken structureel niet nakomen?
Questions whether civil society involvement is adequately guaranteed and whether the dispute settlement mechanism protects investors at the expense of national governments and legislation.
How does this mechanism relate to, and does it not come at the expense of, national governments and national legislation, especially in developing and partner countries?
Hoe verhoudt dit mechanisme zich tot, en gaat dit mechanisme niet ten koste van, nationale overheden en nationale wetgeving, vooral in ontwikkelingslanden en partnerlanden?
Asks for an integral evaluation of Cotonou, the costs of the new regional institutions, and what safeguards enforce return agreements, and what happens if the Tweede Kamer does not approve.
They miss, however, a clear, integral evaluation of that earlier treaty.
Zij missen echter een duidelijke, integrale evaluatie van dat eerdere verdrag.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in July 2024 on the bill approving the Samoa Partnership Agreement replacing Cotonou, asking for clarification of the dispute settlement clause (article 101), its scope and possible countermeasures, and whether the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom are materially affected, which could require approval by rijkswet. The minister's nader rapport of November 2025 adds clarifications to the explanatory memorandum on article 101 and on Kingdom position, but concludes there are no 'gewichtige gevolgen' so an ordinary act suffices.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum on the dispute settlement clause (article 101) was unclear on when it applies and what countermeasures are possible, and was expanded accordingly.

The Afdeling asked whether the agreement has 'gewichtige gevolgen' for the Caribbean countries so that it should be approved by rijkswet; the government concluded there are none and an ordinary act suffices.
The explanatory memorandum did not sufficiently address the position of the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom relative to the ACS states and the Regional Protocol, which was expanded in section 5.

36875.s: The bill implements EU Regulation 2024/2847 (Cyber Resilience Act) in Dutch law by designating the Minister of Economic Affairs as notifying and market surveillance authority, carried out by the RDI, and by granting inspection, undercover, stand-alone order and sanction powers. It includes home entry without the occupant's consent subject to prior authorisation by a rechter-commissaris, and sets appeal routes to the Rotterdam court and the College van Beroep voor het bedrijfsleven.
36875.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as required by the EU Regulation and the Market Surveillance Regulation, and cites the need for effective supervision and enforcement, with safeguards such as prior rechter-commissaris authorisation and appeal routes.
q: The bill provides in Article 2.2 that supervision and enforcement of the CRA rules in the Netherlands are assigned to the Minister of Economic Affairs, who assigns these tasks to the market surveillance authority RDI.

Het wetsvoorstel regelt in artikel 2.2 dat in Nederland het toezicht op en de handhaving van de regels in de CRA worden belegd bij de Minister van Economische Zaken, die deze taken belegt bij markttoezichthouder RDI.
d: detailed rules for implementing the Cyber Resilience Act
p: Allows inspectors to enter a home without the occupant's consent, subject to prior authorisation by the rechter-commissaris with a motivated proportionality and subsidiarity request.
Allows inspectors to acquire products under a false identity without showing their official identification, with a written report required afterwards.

Allows the minister to impose stand-alone orders on online interfaces and intermediaries to remove content or restrict access, prohibiting internet blocking or filtering and requiring prior rechter-commissaris authorisation.
Empowers the minister to impose administrative fines and enforcement orders under bestuursdwang for infringements of the regulation.

parties: Asks how ex-post supervision of update obligations works in practice, how overlapping supervisors coordinate, and whether NCSC preconditions are met.
These members ask the government how supervision of compliance with ex-post obligations, such as timely security updates and handling vulnerabilities, works in practice.

Deze leden vragen de regering hoe in de praktijk toezicht wordt gehouden op de naleving van ex-post verplichtingen, zoals het tijdig uitbrengen van beveiligingsupdates en het adequaat omgaan met kwetsbaarheden.

Worries manufacturers will shorten claimed product lifecycles and that security-by-design may block independent repair; asks the government to curb planned obsolescence and fines that are not deterrent enough.
However, these members are concerned that manufacturers of such products will try to claim that the product lifecycle is shorter than the period the product actually functions.

Deze leden maken zich echter zorgen dat fabrikanten van dergelijke producten zullen proberen te claimen dat de levenscyclus van een product korter is dan de periode dat een dergelijk product daadwerkelijk functioneert.
Concerned about duplicate regulation and compliance costs; requests a schematic overview of overlapping rules and the responsible supervisor per framework.
The VVD members therefore remain concerned about duplicate regulation and high regulatory burden costs.
De leden van de VVD-fractie behouden daarom zorgen over dubbele regelgeving en hoge regeldrukkosten.
Objects to supervisors being empowered to enter homes without consent, a disproportionate intrusion on domestic privacy, and worries about market concentration and costs for small firms.
Asks for explicit government responses to the NCSC quick scan and the Raad voor de rechtspraak advice, and how NCSC can carry out its tasks.
Can the government explicitly address these points and explain which have and have not been adopted, and why?
Kan de regering alsnog expliciet op deze punten ingaan, en daarbij uiteenzetten welke wel en welke niet zijn overgenomen, en waarom?
Has read the bill with interest and has no further questions.
The CDA members have taken note of the bill with interest and have no further questions.
De leden van de CDA-fractie hebben met belangstelling kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel en hebben geen verdere vragen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the draft Dutch implementing act for the EU Cyber Resilience Act and raised no substantive remarks, recommending submission to the House of Representatives. The minister's nader rapport states that a few investigation and enforcement powers under the EU Market Surveillance Regulation were added as an omission correction, with some editorial improvements to the explanatory memorandum.

36884.s: The bill amends the Alcohol Act to require age checks by delivery chain parties when alcohol is delivered, lets the NVWA impose administrative fines and enforce the online sales ban, aligns the fine maximum with the fifth category of the Criminal Code, and removes the mandatory criminal enforcement exception. It also permits small games of chance in hospitality venues.
36884.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to poor compliance with the age limit in online alcohol sales and the need to simplify enforcement and fine-setting.
q: For that reason, Article 20a, first paragraph, part b, of the Alcohol Act requires every online seller of alcoholic drinks to apply a secured working method.
Om die reden eist artikel 20a, eerste lid, onderdeel b, van de Alcoholwet een geborgde werkwijze van iedere verkoper op afstand van alcoholhoudende drank.
d: Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 44aa, eerste lid)
NVWA imposes administrative fines on behalf of the minister
p: Artikel I, onderdeel G (artikel 44aa, eerste lid)
The NVWA gains power to impose administrative fines for age-check and online sales violations, and the ministry may choose between administrative and criminal enforcement.
Artikel I, onderdeel B en D
Extends age-verification duties to delivery chain parties and expands the scope of the prohibition on supplying alcohol to cover delivery.

parties: Asks whether the NVWA has enough capacity to enforce online age checks structurally and how discretion between administrative and criminal enforcement avoids weak sanctions.

These members ask the government, however, whether the NVWA has sufficient capacity and resources to effectively supervise a market in which thousands of online orders and deliveries take place daily.

Deze leden vragen de regering echter of de NVWA over voldoende capaciteit en middelen beschikt om effectief toezicht te houden op een markt waarin dagelijks duizenden online bestellingen en afleveringen plaatsvinden.
Interested in the bill and has no further questions at this point.
At this moment they have no further questions on this.
Op het moment hebben zij hierbij geen verdere vragen.
Supports the bingo exemption but is critical of gambling combined with alcohol; asks for justification of the €400 prize cap and the three-year association requirement.
These members are in general critical of gambling combined with alcohol, which can reinforce each other.
Genoemde leden zijn in algemene zin wel kritisch over gokken in combinatie met alcohol, wat elkaar over en weer kan versterken.
Asks about the risk of a period with insufficient enforceability if the Alcohol Decree and the Act do not enter into force together, and about NVWA feedback to sellers.
Does the government share the members' concern that, without a firm link between the Alcohol Decree and the amendment of the Alcohol Act, there is a risk of a period of insufficient enforceability?

Deelt de regering de zorgen van de leden dat met het ontbreken van een harde koppeling tussen het Alcoholbesluit en de wijziging van de Alcoholwet er een risico ontstaat op een periode met onvoldoende handhaafbaarheid?
Asks for objective criteria for 'incidental' games of chance and for the criteria, guidelines and risk of unequal treatment when choosing between administrative and criminal enforcement.
These members ask on the basis of which criteria this choice will be made.
Deze leden vragen op basis van welke criteria deze keuze zal worden gemaakt.
Has no questions for the Minister on the bill.
These members have no questions for the Minister on this.
Deze leden hebben geen vragen hierover aan de Minister.
Asks for the definition of small games of chance and how the exemption is kept to harmless bingo afternoons; also asks in which cases the NVWA cannot currently enforce.
How is it prevented that the exemption intended for relatively harmless bingo afternoons can be used for more harmful games of chance?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat de uitzondering die bedoeld is voor relatief onschuldige bingomiddagen kan worden gebruikt voor schadelijkere kansspelen?
Worried about normalising alcohol use and about the cross-reference to Article 7c of the Betting and Gaming Act, which could widen the alcohol exemption; also raises risks from webshop-only outlets.
Why was it not chosen to limit the present bill to bingo, which is the subject and reason of this amendment, ask the members of the ChristenUnie faction.

Waarom is er niet voor gekozen om in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel zich te beperken tot bingo, waar de discussie en aanleiding van deze wetswijziging om draait, zo vragen de leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie.
Asks why the government imposes conditions and an association requirement on bingo in hospitality venues rather than simply permitting it.

Why does the government choose such a cumbersome exception rule as meeting the conditions of Article 7c, first paragraph of the Betting and Gaming Act for organising small games of chance, such as a bingo afternoon, in hospitality venues?

Waarom kiest de regering voor zo'n omslachtige uitzonderingsregel als het voldoen aan de voorwaarden van artikel 7c, eerste lid van de Wok voor het organiseren van kleine kansspelen, zoals een bingomiddag, in horecalokaliteiten?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on a draft bill amending the Alcoholwet (online age verification, small games of chance in hospitality venues, and other changes) and made no substantive remarks, advising that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply notes that only some redactional and technical changes were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum, which were submitted to parliament.

36915-X.s: This bill amends the 2026 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence (first supplementary budget), adjusting appropriations and expenditure ceilings across policy articles. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and gives the amendment retroactive effect from 1 June 2026.
q: This concerns the addition of the 2025 year-end margin of about 102 million euros to the Defence budget.
Dit betreft de toevoeging van de eindejaarsmarge 2025 van circa 102 miljoen euro aan de begroting van Defensie.

36938.s: The Fiscal Omnibus Act 2027 amends numerous tax laws, including income tax rules on owner-occupied housing, pension and annuity provisions, payroll withholding and wage tax, corporate and dividend tax, excise, motor vehicle tax, and the legal protection for deferral and remission of local taxes. It shifts disputes over deferral and remission of national taxes to the tax courts while keeping administrative appeal for local taxes for now, and adds several rule-making delegations to ministers and general administrative orders.
36938.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations mainly on technical and administrative grounds, such as EU state-aid recommendations and the need to adjust rules quickly.
q: The cabinet adopts the Commission's recommendation and for that purpose proposes a delegation basis, modelled on existing legislation, under which conditions may be set by general administrative order.

111 Het kabinet neemt de aanbeveling van de EC over en stelt daartoe – naar voorbeeld van bestaande wet- en regelgeving 112 – een delegatiegrondslag voor op grond waarvan bij algemene maatregel van bestuur genoemde voorwaarden kunnen worden vastgelegd.
d: Artikel III, onderdeel B (artikel 19b, zevende lid, Wet LB 1964)
conditions under which late-paid pension is exempt from wage tax consequences
Artikel XIV, onderdeel A (artikel 7, achtste lid, Awir)
exclusion of designated assets from means test for allowances
rules on state aid from tax laws
p: Artikel XV, onderdelen B en D (Provinciewet 232da, 232ea); Artikel XVI; Artikel XVII
Local tax deferral and remission decisions remain subject only to administrative appeal rather than court review, with a later evaluation promised.
Artikel XIX, onderdeel E; Artikel XX, onderdeel A
Tax collection and appeal rules are extended to cover Wet fiscale arbitrage decisions.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion on the draft Fiscale verzamelwet 2027 and raised no remarks, advising that the bill be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Staatssecretaris van Financiën's nader rapport notes that the advice was received and that only some editorial changes were made to the bill and explanatory memorandum.

36947.s: The bill introduces a annual green gas blending obligation (jaarverplichting groengaseenheden) on gas suppliers to end users in ETS2 sectors, measured in CO2-equivalent chain emission reduction, tradeable via a GGE register managed by the NEa. It sets out delegations for a general administrative order (AMvB) and ministerial regulations on the obligation, buy-out, savings, register, and supervision, with the NEa empowered to impose penalties and fines.
36947.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for flexibility to adjust the growth path and technical detail under unforeseen market conditions and to align with EU rules.
q: Although the starting point is that the growth path up to 2031 will be fixed, unforeseen circumstances in the green gas market may make adjustment of the growth path necessary.
Hoewel het uitgangspunt is dat het groeipad tot 2031 vast zal staan, kunnen er onvoorziene omstandigheden in de groengasmarkt plaatsvinden die aanpassing van het groeipad noodzakelijk maken.
d: data entry and checks in the EU databank for green gas producers
exempting categories of gas suppliers from obligations
amount of the annual obligation and calculation of supplier share
buy-out payment amount, maximum exemption share and payment rules
reporting and holding of green gas units in the register
data to be stated when booking renewable gas and conditions for booker
sustainability and greenhouse gas reduction criteria for renewable gas
market participant requirements and mass balance system
suspension or refusal of crediting green gas units
ex officio determination of booked renewable gas
operation, organisation and security of the GGE register
fee for opening and maintaining a register account
share of unused green gas units that may be saved
checks on raw material sustainability for renewable gas producers
p: Allows the NEa to ex officio determine booked renewable gas and adjust unit balances up to five years after booking.
Allows the NEa to suspend or refuse crediting of green gas units on suspicion of abuse or fraud or other reasons.
Allows the NEa to refuse, block or close register accounts on grounds of suspected fraud or non-compliance.
Empowers the NEa to impose administrative fines up to the sixth category or 10% of turnover, and to bar a renewable gas producer from booking gas.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the Green Gas Blending Obligation bill, raising concerns about NEa supervision without a fully operational EU databank, the conditions for crediting emission reductions, the evaluation design and term, and EU law and notification issues. The government's reply accepts the advice on mandatory sustainability criteria, adds explanations on supervision, double counting, evaluation and EU law, and says the bill was amended accordingly.
concerns: The Council questioned whether effective supervision of the supply chain is possible while the EU databank is not yet fully operational; the government argues supervision remains possible via certification bodies and explained it in the explanatory memorandum.

The Council advised clarifying the relationship with EU law, free movement of goods and services and freedom of establishment; the government added this to the explanatory memorandum and notification section.
The Council advised turning the optional power to set sustainability criteria by ministerial regulation into a mandatory obligation; the government adopted this in article 9.9.4.2.

The Council asked the explanatory memorandum to address whether double counting of emission reductions under the blending obligation and the renewable energy obligation for transport is possible; the government added a section explaining why it is not.

The Council advised justifying the shorter evaluation term and broadening the evaluation to climate goals and consumer costs; the government added these points to the evaluation provision and memorandum.
